Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8795.objectivesText: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
8795.title: The Alliance Needs Your Help!

8796.description: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $n!$B$BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
8796.objectivesText: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
8796.title: The Alliance Needs Your Help!

8827.description: I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokeywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Ironforge. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.$b$bBut you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.
8827.objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
8827.title: Winter's Presents

8859.description: My servants were nearly killed in their efforts to recover this sample. You absolutely must hurry! Lord Maxwell Tyrosus eagerly awaits a fresh husk sample. He believes that the secrets of this Colossus could help us in the war against the Scourge!$B$BWhy are you still here!? To Light's Hope! Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...
8859.objectivesText: Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
8859.title: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora

8861.description: Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!$B$BIt should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!$B$BWell anyway, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!$B$BThanks, $n!  Innkeeper Pala is in the inn near the bridge to Hunter's Rise.
8861.objectivesText: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff.
8861.title: New Year Celebrations!

8867.description: Every year the druids of Moonglade hold a celebration of our city's great triumph over an ancient evil.$B$BWe celebrate the wisdom of our elders, share in magnificent feasts and of course... shoot fireworks!$B$BFor a small donation you can purchase colorful rockets from our vendor.  Try using some of the launchers around here, $n.
8867.objectivesText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.
8867.title: Lunar Fireworks

8868.description: The beast Omen was once a hero of this world.  A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics.  Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.$B$BFinally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara.  But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...$B$BGather cohorts, $n, and summon and defeat the beast Omen.  Earn the blessing of Elune!
8868.objectivesText: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing.  Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
8868.title: Elune's Blessing

8869.description: Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.$B$BUnderstand this: Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.
8869.objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
8869.title: Sweet Serenity

8872.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8872.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8872.title: The Lunar Festival

8873.description: It's that time of the year, $n!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
8873.objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
8873.title: The Lunar Festival

8899.description: How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.$b$bThese mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.$b$bI've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
8899.objectivesText: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
8899.title: Dearest Colara,

8903.description: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the Alliance itself.$b$bJust think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? Something must be done.$b$bGo to one of the guards here in Stormwind and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
8903.objectivesText: Get a Stormwind Guard's Card and return it to Aristan Mottar in Stormwind.
8903.title: Dangerous Love

8905.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8905.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
8905.title: An Earnest Proposition

8908.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8908.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Lightforge Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
8908.title: An Earnest Proposition

8911.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8911.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
8911.title: An Earnest Proposition

8912.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
8912.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
8912.title: An Earnest Proposition

8913.description: Hail, $c!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
8913.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8913.title: An Earnest Proposition

8915.description: Hail, $c!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
8915.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Magister's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8915.title: An Earnest Proposition

8921.description: Ah, you're in need of my latest project... the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!  Unfortunately I've run out of funds and manpower.$B$BYou're willing to help?  Excellent!  Our first task is to build a device to harvest the very fabric of death!  Building an ectoplasmic distiller won't be an easy task, $n.$B$BI'll need you to bring me an arcanite converter, some greater eternal essences and stonescale oil. I'll also need some volcanic ash from the lava pools in the Burning Steppes to build a filter.
8921.objectivesText: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.
8921.title: The Ectoplasmic Distiller

8924.description: A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself!  You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.$B$BYou see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead.  The tortured night elves of Silithus, the spirits of the highborne from Winterspring and the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need.  Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
8924.objectivesText: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8924.title: Hunting for Ectoplasm

8925.description: Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active.  I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat!$B$BIt's said he can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain.  Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
8925.objectivesText: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8925.title: A Portable Power Source

8927.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
8927.objectivesText: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8927.title: Just Compensation

8928.description: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.$B$BI met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods.  He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly.  I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.$B$BHe lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge.  Sneak in there and try to find him.$B$BMake sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
8928.objectivesText: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8928.title: A Shifty Merchant

8935.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
8935.objectivesText: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
8935.title: Just Compensation

8936.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
8936.objectivesText: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
8936.title: Just Compensation

8943.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
8943.objectivesText: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8943.title: Just Compensation

8953.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
8953.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
8953.title: Anthion's Parting Words

8964.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.$B$BThe siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
8964.objectivesText: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8964.title: Components of Importance

8970.description: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.$B$BThis is where you come in, $n. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
8970.objectivesText: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8970.title: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...

8985.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BIsalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8985.objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8985.title: More Components of Importance

8998.description: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.$B$BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in Orgrimmar and tell him what's happened.
8998.objectivesText: Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
8998.title: Back to the Beginning

9003.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
9003.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
9003.title: Saving the Best for Last

9015.description: Heed me well, $n.  For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths.  Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.$B$BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you.  Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
9015.objectivesText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.  Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
9015.title: The Challenge

9016.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9016.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
9016.title: Anthion's Parting Words

9019.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9019.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
9019.title: Anthion's Parting Words

9021.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9021.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
9021.title: Anthion's Parting Words

9031.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck, and you shall need it!
9031.title: <TXT>Anthion's Parting Words

9032.description: The medallion contained Valthalak's soul?  It's no surprise it was guarded by such a powerful curse.$B$BLocating Bodley presents a bit of a problem.  Last time I heard of him, he was preparing to venture back into Blackrock Spire.  He was never heard of again.$B$BSeek him out in Blackrock Mountain, though I'm afraid to say he's probably dead by now.  I suggest taking the goblin's device with you, friend.
9032.objectivesText: Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
9032.title: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate

9053.description: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$b$bIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$b$bReturn to me when this is done.
9053.objectivesText: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
9053.title: A Better Ingredient

9085.description: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.$b$bIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
9085.objectivesText: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
9085.title: Shadows of Doom

9128.description: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.$B$BAll I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!$B$BYou'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
9128.objectivesText: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.
9128.title: The Elemental Equation

9141.description: You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.$B$BIf you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.$B$BAnd there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
9141.objectivesText: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.
9141.title: They Call Me "The Rooster"

9262.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Darnassus from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9262.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9262.title: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus

9264.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Thunder Bluff from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9264.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9264.title: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff

9299.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9299.objectivesText: Take the Careworn Note to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9299.title: Note from the Front

9301.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9301.objectivesText: Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9301.title: Envelope from the Front

9304.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9304.objectivesText: Take the Smudged Document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9304.title: Document from the Front

9310.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
9310.objectivesText: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal

9323.description: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$b$bYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$b$b Return once your journey is done.
9323.objectivesText: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9323.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms

9324.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9324.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
9324.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame

9332.description: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9332.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
9332.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame

9362.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor.  Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
9362.objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
9362.title: Warlord Krellian

9368.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.title: The Festival of Fire

9415.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$b$bWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$b$bNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
9415.objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9415.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall

9419.description: We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.$b$bHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.$b$bIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
9419.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9419.title: Scouring the Desert

9422.description: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$b$bBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$b$bI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
9422.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9422.title: Scouring the Desert

9556.description: You've no doubt been fighting long and hard among the towers, $r. We would like to give something back to you in return for your defense of these lands, but first, you must prove to us you understand the weight of the tragedies that took place here.$b$bWalk the streets of Stratholme and find a vial of the holy water. Once you have it, travel to the mage quarter of Stormwind or the Undercity... There, if you are victorious within these lands, you will find my colleague.
9556.objectivesText: Collect a bottle of Stratholme Holy Water from within the city of Stratholme and deliver it to the Lordaeron Mage within the Mage Quarter of Stormwind or the Undercity when your side is victorious in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9556.title: To The Victor...

9665.description: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.$b$bIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
9665.objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
9665.title: Bolstering Our Defenses

66281.description: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
66281.objectivesText: Take the Book of Deathstones to Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas.
66281.title: Book of Deathstones

66289.description: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
66289.objectivesText: Take the Book of Deathstones to Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas.
66289.title: Book of Deathstones

76160.description: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.objectivesText: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Delgren the Purifier might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>

78088.description:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature. 

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.objectivesText: Bring the Althalaxx Orb to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.
78088.title: A Strange Artifact

78092.description:
The tendrils of sentience reaching out from this orb are too much for even an experienced warlock like myself to withstand for long. I am reluctant to admit this, $n, but the orb must be destroyed.

The orb is nearly impervious, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I have heard that such a blade is present in Ashenvale--at the site where the pit lord Mannoroth was destroyed.

Gather motes of the fallen demon's essence there, then shatter the orb upon the blade.
78092.objectivesText: Gather 12 Motes of Mannoroth from demons in Ashenvale. Bring them along with the Orb of Althalaxx to the Spear of Mannoroth at Demon Fall Canyon.
78092.title: It Must Be Destroyed

78093.description: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectivesText: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.title: Return to Delgren

78823.description: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

78830.description:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.objectivesText: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79098.description: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
79098.objectivesText: Bring the Silverwing Sentinel Charm to Kazragore, Far Seer, at the Bonfire base in Ashenvale.
79098.title: Clear the Forest!

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79235.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $n. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectivesText: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.title: On the Lam

79358.description:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $n. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79361.description:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79442.description: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442.objectivesText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
79442.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79483.description: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79483.objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79483.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79677.description:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.
79677.objectivesText: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
79677.title: A Quick Grocery Run

79939.description:
<An ornate broken warhammer lies surrounded by dead Burning Blade Cultists and Scarlet Crusade warriors. A fight clearly happened here, and fairly recently. You also recognize this as the weapon of a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand. 

While you've seen many hammers like this one, the quality and worksmanship of this weapon is fairly unique. You should search the area for clues, and return to Katherine with the broken hammer.>
79939.objectivesText: Recover clues about the recent battle at Mannoroc Coven, and return the Broken Warhammer to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
79939.title: The Broken Hammer

79940.description:
<Katherine winces as she holds the shattered fragments of the broken hammer> 

I won't speak of this weapon's master in detail for the telling would fill me with shame, but I'll tell you what I can.

objectives.text: Speak with Katherine and Learn More

79940.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure and learn more about the broken hammer.
79940.title: A Lost Brother

79945.description:
This appears to be orders from the Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade himself, Dathrohan. It seems that Aeonas has run afoul of the Crusade. Judging by the scene before you, it appears that the Crusade was able to follow Aeonas here and apprehend him. It appears that he did not go down without a fight.

The charges levied against Aeonas are grave, but that would explain some of the scene you came upon in Desolace.

objectives.text: Report back to Katherine the Pure

79945.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the Grand Crusader back to Katherine the Pure.
79945.title: Orders from the Grand Crusader

79946.description: Due to the... unfortunate nature of why he left the order, it would be bad comedy for Aeonas to die at the hands of the Scarlet Crusade now. The Crusade is an organization of zealots and lunatics and they've been growing increasingly brazen in their willingness to commit violence against anyone who they imagine to be enemies of the light. Go to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and find out if Aeonas still lives.

objectives.text: Learn more about Aeonas from Katherine
Find Aeonas in the Scarlet Monastery

79946.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine to learn more about Aeonas, and then find him in the Scarlet Monastery.
79946.title: A Brother In Need

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79970.description:
Thank you for saving me, $c. It seems that I'm not as young as I once was, and I think I'm going to need allies for what is to come. Please, meet me in Stormwind in the Cathedral of Light as soon as you are able.

Don't worry about me, I can find my way out of here on my own. I just need a few moments to recover my strength

objectives.text: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind

79970.objectivesText: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
79970.title: Aeonas the Vindicated

79974.description:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974.objectivesText: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.
79974.title: Wet Job

79976.description:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.objectivesText: Whoever was here, you just missed them.
79976.title: This Must Be The Place

79980.description: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.title: Scramble

80411.description:
From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak. 

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.  

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
80411.objectivesText: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.
80411.title: The Talisman of Kazdor

80453.description:
Take the talisman down to Zan Shivsprocket, in the basement. I've asked him to rig the artifact with a mechanism that will detect any attempt to channel magic energy into, or out of, it.

The mechanism is all but invisible to the naked eye, and will detonate when triggered. With any luck, Caius will be killed in the blast. At the very least, his plans for the talisman will be foiled.
80453.objectivesText: Bring the Talisman of Kazdor to Zan Shivsprocket in the basement of Ravenholdt Manor.
80453.title: Best Laid Plans

81731.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat ogres there and return to me.
81731.objectivesText: Defeat 3 Deranged Ogres and 3 Demented Fire Weavers in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81731.title: Duskwood Mission II: Defeat Ogres

81733.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Thalinar there and return to me.
81733.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Thalinar in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep inside the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81733.title: Duskwood Mission IV: Ogre Intelligence

81739.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Nightmare Moss from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
81739.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nightmare Moss in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81739.title: Duskwood Mission X: Nightmare Moss

81742.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat the dragon Ylanthrius there and return to me.
81742.objectivesText: Defeat Ylanthrius in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead field and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81742.title: Duskwood Mission XIII: Defeat Ylanthrius

81743.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat the ogre warlord Vvarc'zul there and return to me.
81743.objectivesText: Defeat Vvarc'zul in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion deep in the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81743.title: Duskwood Mission XIV: Defeat Vvarc'zul

81745.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Kroll Mountainshade there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81745.objectivesText: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade from the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the guest house at the Rotting Orchard and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81745.title: Duskwood Mission XVI: Rescue Kroll Mountainshade

81747.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Elenora Marshwalker there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81747.objectivesText: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion in the ruins of a farmhouse near the Vul'gol Ogre Mound and return to Field Captain Palandar.
81747.title: Duskwood Mission XVIII: Rescue Elenora Marshwalker

81773.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Lanaria there and return to me.
81773.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Lanaria in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion inside Kargathia Keep at the Warsong Lumber Camp and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
81773.title: Ashenvale Mission VI: Treant Intelligence

81774.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Dreamengine and deliver it to me.
81774.objectivesText: Recover the Dreamengine in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion from the forge at Warsong Lumber Camp and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
81774.title: Ashenvale Mission VII: Recover Dreamengine

81781.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Defeat the satyr Zalius there and return to me.
81781.objectivesText: Defeat Zalius in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion at the base of the ziggurat in Satyrnaar and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
81781.title: Ashenvale Mission XIV: Defeat Zalius

81790.description:
Each of the Echoing Orbs is attuned to a different aspect of its master. The method you used in Ashenvale to destroy the Althalaxx Orb will not be effective on the orb we possess. I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. 

Take this, it should help you in your search.
81790.objectivesText: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.
81790.title: Materials of Significance

81820.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Valori there and return to me.
81820.objectivesText: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Valori in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the underground lake in Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81820.title: Hinterlands Mission VI: Moonkin Intelligence

81826.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Retrieve a Star-Touched Dragonegg and deliver it to me.
81826.objectivesText: Recover a Star-Touched Dragonegg in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion from the central hut at Agol'wath and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81826.title: Hinterlands Mission VII: Recover Star-Touched Dragonegg

81833.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Star Lotus from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
81833.objectivesText: Gather 10 Star Lotus in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81833.title: Hinterlands Mission X: Star Lotus

81837.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Agol'watha. Defeat the dragon Florius there and return to me.
81837.objectivesText: Defeat Florius in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the main courtyard in Agol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81837.title: Hinterlands Mission XIII: Defeat Florius

81850.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Agol'watha. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Elianar Shadowdrinker there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81850.objectivesText: Rescue Elianar Shadowdrinker from the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at the troll fortification near Agol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81850.title: Hinterlands Mission XVI: Rescue Elianar Shadowdrinker

81852.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Veanna Cloudsleeper there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81852.objectivesText: Rescue Veanna Cloudsleeper from the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion in the hammock above Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
81852.title: Hinterlands Mission XVIII: Rescue Veanna Cloudsleeper

81867.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough and collect Moondragon Scales from the dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.
81867.objectivesText: Gather 10 Moondragon Scales in the Feralas Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
81867.title: Feralas Mission XII: Greater Moondragon Scales

81871.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Ruins of Ravenwind. Defeat the harpy "queen" Slirena there and return to me.
81871.objectivesText: Defeat Slirena in the Feralas Nightmare Incursion near the ziggurat in the Ruins of Ravenwind and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
81871.title: Feralas Mission XV: Defeat Slirena

81872.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Mellias Earthtender there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81872.objectivesText: Rescue Mellias Earthtender from the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the stairs by Jademir Lake in Oneiros and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
81872.title: Feralas Mission XVI: Rescue Mellias Earthtender

81873.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Nerene Brooksinger there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
81873.objectivesText: Rescue Nerene Brooksinger from the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the campfire at the Twin Colossals and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
81873.title: Feralas Mission XVII: Rescue Nerene Brooksinger

81900.description:
<The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". 

Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims.

You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>
81900.objectivesText: Find an expert on the beasts of the Blasted Lands.
81900.title: The Burning Beast

81924.description:
Whatever Kaldorei knowledge you seek will not be found among these ruins, $c. Not anymore.

However, while the physical lies in ruin, the spiritual remains.

Seek the guardian spirits of Azshara, the Hinterlands, and Feralas. You will know them by their shrines. Prove yourself to them, and heed their words. Their wisdom will be passed on to you, so that it will not be lost to time as so much was here.
81924.objectivesText: Prove yourself to the guardian spirits of Feralas, Azshara, and the Hinterlands, then return to Tyrisius in Feralas.
81924.title: Wisdom of the Guardians

82068.description: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands today and you'll earn an extra reward.

objectives.text: Complete a Nightmare Incursion Mission in Hinterlands or Feralas

82068.objectivesText: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands and then report to Field Captain Korlian or Field Captain Arunnel.
82068.title: Fight the Nightmare Incursions

82083.description: This prestine scapula is all too recognizable -- Hakkar was summoned into the physical world and defeated. The trolls on Yojamba Island will want to hear more about what happened inside of Sunken Temple.
82083.objectivesText: Bring the Scapula of the Fallen Avatar to Molthor in Yojamba Isle.
82083.title: A Broken Ritual

83934.description: Heya! You look like the "resourceful adventurer" type so maybe you can help me out. See, my brothers and I came from Kezan looking to start up a new business venture but we ran afoul of some pirates who stole our startup money. The people who are funding our operation back home aren't exactly what I'd call understanding, so we'd make it worth your while if are able to find any of the coin and return it. It's no ordinary gold but you should know it when you see it.
83934.objectivesText: Bring a Tarnished Undermine Real to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
83934.title: Show Me the Money!

84124.description: The spectral champion yields and motions toward the altar.
84124.objectivesText: Return to the Altar of Reverence
84124.title: Legacy of Valor

84146.description:
What you want is safely hidden, and I can only hope the same can be said for what I'm looking for.

I had a red bag containing some valuable tooling that I use for electro-optics. But, I lost it in a zeppelin accident over Burning Steppes! The bag could still be there, but with orcs, ogres, and poachers, I've had to put my work on hold.

If you can locate it and bring it back to me, I'll let you have Jurgens' old book.
84146.objectivesText: Locate the Red Bag that Nami in Everlook lost in a zeppelin mishap over Burning Steppes.
84146.title: Red Bag Blues

84152.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
84152.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
84152.title: An Earnest Proposition

84153.title: An Earnest Proposition

Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
84156.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84156.title: An Earnest Proposition

Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.

84157.title: An Earnest Proposition

Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
84158.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Devout Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84158.title: An Earnest Proposition

84166.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84166.objectivesText: Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Deliana in Ironforge.
84166.title: Just Compensation

84167.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84167.objectivesText: Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
84167.title: Just Compensation

84168.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.

84168.title: Just Compensation

84169.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84169.objectivesText: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
84169.title: Just Compensation

84171.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
84171.objectivesText: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
84171.title: Just Compensation

84181.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
84181.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
84181.title: Anthion's Parting Words

84190.title: Anthion's Parting Words

84197.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
84197.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
84197.title: Saving the Best for Last

84198.description: That's an amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
84198.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Lightforge Helm and Lightforge Breastplate.
84198.title: Saving the Best for Last

84203.description: A truly amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
84203.objectivesText: Give Mokvar your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
84203.title: Saving the Best for Last

84206.description: A truly amazing story, $n! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.$B$BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
84206.objectivesText: Give Mokvar your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
84206.title: Saving the Best for Last

84213.description:
Join me in this historic experiment and witness the wonders of my invention! I've calculated two locations with suitable geothermic bioflux energy. With manual-auto-locking phasers, I'm ready to send us to the coordinates within compatible regions.

Once you're at compatible coordinates, use this remote transponder to send the signal to me. I'll configure the warp transmitter to fold the space between here, and there.

What I'm saying is, I'll meet you there when you say you're ready!
84213.objectivesText:
Use the Distant Communication Device to send the signal to Jurgens at either Tirisfal Glades or Westfall
Then, assist him in demonstrating the capabilities of his elecro transmitter.
84213.title: Rift Away

84414.description:
<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?

objectives.text: Send Orthas' Spirit On His Way

84414.objectivesText: Observe Orthas as he moves on from this world.
84414.title: Send Me On Me Way

85442.description: Examine the vessel that was used to release the ephemeral storm. It is from this that the Windseeker was reborn, and now he draws upon The Crystal Vale for renewed power.
85442.objectivesText: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian
85442.title: Examine the Vessel

85712.description: Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. It is an addiction that I dare never give up, $n.$B$BI can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.$B$BIf you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.
85712.objectivesText: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.
85712.title: The Art of the Armorsmith

86576.description:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

86577.description:
The corruption that rains down from Hyjal flows through the mountain's waters and seeps into everything here in the wood. The creatures that drink the water take the corruption into themselves. It makes them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

To counter these effects, I must understand them, and to do that I need samples from the afflicted.

A few samples of putrescent organs from the wolves and bears should do. Take your time; the creatures are common here in Felwood.
86577.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Putrescent Bear Organs and $2oa Putrescent Wolf Organs to Kelek Skykeeper.
86577.title: A Sampling of Putrescence

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86614.description: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.objectivesText: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.title: Silver of the Waves

86620.description:
Though we have a good line of gryphons here, there are always a few egg clutches in the wild that are in danger of not making it. A gryphon parent can lose a fight against a wolf, or fall sick. Without help, the fledglings will never survive.

Fortunately, we have the means to raise and protect lost young ones like this. If you find lost eggs in the wild, bring them to me.
86620.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Lost Gryphon Eggs for Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
86620.title: Fledgling Rescue

86667.description:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.objectivesText: Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.
86667.title: Snowbound

86746.description:
My people are struggling, $n. 

The Legashi satyr have invaded our den, corrupting many of the Blackmaw and separating us from our Timbermaw allies. Those of us who survive their attacks are huddled in makeshift camps. Worse still, the satyr's corruption is spreading across the land, and poses a threat to my already vulnerable tribe.

The Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of here. I must ask you for help in defeating them.
86746.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Satyr, $2oa Legashi Rogues, and $3oa Legashi Hellcallers for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarth.
86746.title: The Legashi Threat

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86776.description:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.
86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge

86791.description:
Not long ago I sent a party of scouts to gather information on the Legashi stronghold and possibly find our chieftain. They have yet to return. I am beginning to fear the worst.

The Legashi have many camps to the east of here. If any members of the party are still alive they are likely somewhere nearby.
86791.objectivesText: Find the Blackmaw scouting party near the Legashi camps east of Ursolan.
86791.title: Missing Blackmaw Scouts

86798.description:
With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, $n.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.
86798.objectivesText: Speak to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold and ask him to provide reinforcements.
86798.title: Timbermaw Reinforcements

86804.description:
Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
86804.objectivesText: Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.
86804.title: An Unlikely Source

86925.description:
It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.
86925.objectivesText: Find a Legashi Firewater Recipe from satyr in the Legashi Encampment.
86925.title: Toil and Trouble

86927.description:
As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.
86927.objectivesText: Bring the Legashi Firewater to Elder Bramblesnap at Ursolan.
86927.title: Running Firewater

87346.description:
When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
87346.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.
87346.title: Chieftain Bloodmaw

87491.areaDescription: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
87491.description:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
87491.objectivesText: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
87491.title: Spark of Freedom

87492.description:
