You may have seen some of the unusual crystal growths that dot this crater. I'm not a miner, but these growths don't seem to fit with the kinds of soil deposits all around here.

I believe I caught sight of a damaged crystal not far from here while I was foraging. I wonder if it holds any secrets about the origins of these strange formations? If you happen to spot it, I would love to investigate a sample piece.
87492.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Damaged Blue Crystal back to Torwa Pathfinder.
87492.title: Uncanny Crystal

87494.description:
This scale is slightly more reflective and iridescent than the others, as if it's embedded with tiny particles of crystal.

Torwa Pathfinder might be able to make something of this.
87494.objectivesText: Take the Crystal Infused Scale to Torwa Pathfinder.
87494.title: Microcrystal Contamination

88756.description:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Explosives from the Dark Iron Dwarf camps.
88756.title: Bring Back a Bang

88807.description:
Azshara may appear beautiful, but it is a cursed place. There are horrors deep beneath its waters, waiting to emerge and tear the world asunder.

All we can do for now is fight the horrors that have already surfaced.

The Spitelash Naga occupy the Ruins of Eldarath to the north east. The ones within the ruins are well-fortified, so we must pick off the weaker ones along the outskirts first.

As you can see, we could always use another fighter here, if you are up to the task.
88807.objectivesText: Kill 8 Spitelash Warriors and 8 Spitelash Screamers for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88807.title: Slay the Spitelash

88809.description:
Millennia ago, Eldarath was a sight to behold; a living testament to the glory and might of the Kaldorei. What we call Eldarath today is hardly a pile of rubble by comparison.

Nonetheless, what remains is worth salvaging, if only to preserve our history. The Spitelash must be driven out before Eldarath is completely ransacked.

Following the road north east will lead you right into the heart of the ruins. Go there, and retrieve as many of our relics as you can--and their commander's head.
88809.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Eldarath Relics from Spitelash Serpent Guards, Spitelash Sirens, and Spitelash Myrmidons, and Lord Sarthiss' Head for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88809.title: Preserving Eldarath

88857.areaDescription: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment
88857.description:
<The sentinel speaks in a low whisper>

Listen, $c, before they hear us. I am a sentinel from Talrendis Point. The satyr here believe me injured, but I am only feigning; waiting for the moment they drop their guard and I can escape.

Your arrival is perhaps such a moment.

Help me out of here, would you?
88857.objectivesText: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment, then speak to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.
88857.title: Saving a Sentinel

88884.description:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
88884.objectivesText: Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88884.title: Highborne Tablets

89001.description:
Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
89001.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89001.title: Home on the Range

89038.description:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
89038.objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89038.title: A Monumental Task

89053.description:
I know you were initially sent here on reconnaissance, $n, but you've done a great deal for the field of archaeology.

Surely, after all of your toil, you'd like to know what fruits my studies will come to bear.

To that end, before you return to your camp, I'd like to show you something. Would you oblige me?

objectives.text: See what Saria has to show you

89053.objectivesText: See what Saria has to show you.
89053.title: Your Final Reward

89228.description:
Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Squid are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.
89228.objectivesText: Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point, in Azshara.
89228.title: Winter Frontier Fishery

89340.description:
To the Esteemed Head Chef of New Avalon: Carrie Hearthfire,

I trust this letter finds you in good spirits! Your departure from Hearthglen has left a hole in our hearts, and in our stomachs. Not a day passes by without a complaint of the morning gruel, yearning for the next delightful meal.

To that end we are planning a banquet; one which we intend to serve only the finest dishes in Lordaeron: yours.

An escorted caravan will arrive in a fortnight. You and your meals ought best be prepared.
89340.title: Preposterously Prosed Postage

90487.description:
$n, I have little more to offer. If you mean to make the long trek up the mountain, you might do well to speak with some of its ancient caretakers.

Follow the road to the west. Look north, toward the foot of the mountain. You will eventually see an outpost, a remnant of the guardians that once roamed the slopes. There is an ancient there named Fraxinus. He and his friends can assist you.
90487.objectivesText: Travel west from the hermit's cave to find an outpost of ancients and dryads on the lower slopes of Mount Hyjal.
90487.title: Ancient Allies

90647.description:
With all of the ingredients you assembled I was able infuse the staff you recovered with a new magic. You should now be able to bring this to bear to counteract the magic of the Wild Gods that Ve'han has so brazenly stolen.

We will need to test it, however. Bring this to the druid known as Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity. She may be able to help.
90647.objectivesText: Bring the Staff of the Mountain to Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity.
90647.title: The Staff of the Mountain

90854.description:
Livin' out in da wild for five years done take a toll on our supplies. We had to make dis place from scratch! We could use your skills as a leatherworker.

I need to repair some of da tents and buildings, and patch up some armor. You bring me a pair of Rugged Armor Kits and a Cured Rugged Hide, I help you turn it into something special.
90854.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Rugged Armor Kits and $2oa Cured Rugged Hide to Zet'gan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
90854.title: Leather for Inclement Weather

90865.description:
Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains.

Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult.

Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
90865.title: Eyes of the Watchers

90902.description:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.objectivesText: Heal $1oa Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
90902.title: Rediscovering the Light

91285.description:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91317.description:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.title: The Tarnished

91488.description:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
91488.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.
91488.title: Home on the Range

91531.description: Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself!$B$BAh, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, $n.
91531.objectivesText: Bring the Head of Magus Rimtori to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
91531.title: Revenge Exacted

91608.description:
There are few luxuries out here on the frontier. A barrel of good drink would surely boost the camp's morale.

In my younger days, I took a recipe for a delicious brew off the corpse of a dwarf I killed. All I need is some honey. Fortunately, the wasp nests to the west are overflowing with it.

Take my pellet gun. This will allow you to knock the nests out of the trees. Be warned, however, it will do little against the wasps themselves.
91608.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Wild Honey from Wasp Nests using Kurll's Pellet Gun.
91608.title: Gettin' Buzzed

91685.description:
When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff.

I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline.

If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich!

If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.
91685.objectivesText: Use the Mana-Siphoning Wand on the Leyline Rift in Lake Mennar and bring the Tear of Mennar to Izvi Gildfizz.
91685.title: Ley of the Land

91688.description:
You've managed to cut a swath through the undead that have kept us trapped here for so many years, and for that we can never repay you.

I have one more favor to ask, on behalf of us all. We know that there are druids at the summit. They protect Nordrassil and the Well of Eternity.

Why did they never come help us to escape?

For five years we have been trapped here. At last we have a glimmer of hope... but why didn't the druids come for us?

Let someone know that we're still alive!
91688.objectivesText: Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.
91688.title: To the Summit of Eternity

91697.description:
Thank you for helping gather bear berries. Small steps build trust! With the aroma of berry resin on you, the Elders should be more welcoming of you. 

Go and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker.
91697.objectivesText: Find and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker within Barkskin Burrow.
91697.title: Meet the Elders

91723.description:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723.objectivesText: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91723.title: Delicate Instruments

91724.description:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, $n. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
91724.title: Delicate Instruments

91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.title: Good Steel

91734.description:
<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
91734.title: Remote Contact

91737.description:
My duties occasionally require reagents from the farther corners of Azeroth. However, I am always needed here in Thunder Bluff, and so I am in need of competent aides.

To that end, I am awaiting a delivery from an orc named Jediga, in Azshara. If you care to make yourself useful, find her camp, and inquire as to when I can expect it to arrive.
91737.title: Remote Contact

91740.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.objectivesText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.title: Croaky's Head

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91746.description: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.objectivesText: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91746.title: Elmpaw's Head

91753.description:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.objectivesText:
Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectivesText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772.description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.objectivesText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.
91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

91777.description:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
91777.title: Rare Books

91858.description:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.objectivesText: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.title: Diplomatic Incident

91862.description:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
91862.title: Lumina Windsinger

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

92009.description:
There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle.

Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal.

If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?

objectives.text: Shipment delivered to Mount Hyjal before it expires

92009.objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.
92009.title: Crate Expectations

92015.description:
You say you want to help? Alright, I've got a task for ya.

Ever been skunked on a hot day? Nothing worse, I tell you. Bloody things cover everything within spittin' distance in the most vile lingering stench!

A family of skunks have started making their home behind my equipment crates. Help me gently expel them from our perimeter and I'll think about sharing some of this gear, once we can get to it...

I can't stress this enough: don't attack them - they WILL spray you!
92015.objectivesText: Make skunks leave the area around Johun's equipment without killing them.
92015.title: Area Denial Skunks

92017.description:
The flying creatures of the Summit still draw breath from the highest currents, where the corruption has not yet fully taken hold. Hippogryph feathers and chimaera hair drift through these winds, absorbing what the air remembers of an unspoiled land. I need these remnants to anchor and strengthen my purifying incense.

Gather them for me, so I may concentrate the wind's knowledge into cleansing smoke before we begin the ritual.
92017.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Grand Hippogryph Feathers and $2oa Oily Chimaera Hair for Marn.
92017.title: Cleansing Winds

92020.description:
I've been taking notes and making drawings in my sketchbooks of all of the creatures living in Un'Goro Crater, and I made a few copies so that I can send them to people who might be interested!

I have a sketchbook copy here that I've been meaning to get into the hands of the druids on Mount Hyjal, since I know that they love to study the natural world.

Hyjal's a bit of a trip, though. Do you think you could take it along in case you go there?
92020.objectivesText: Take Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards to a druid at the summit of Mount Hyjal.
92020.title: Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards

92065.description:
Will you aid us in our final battle, $r, and be a savior to the Blackmaw?

Varrox Bleakhoof, bane of the Blackmaw: a demon whose appetite for destruction will never be satisfied. His corruption consumes all that it touches. Even now, he and his underlings continue to lay waste to our burrows.

We've come far in our fight against the Legashi, but for the Blackmaw to ever have a future, Varrox must fall.

Find him in Blackmaw Hold, and strike him down. Only then can the Blackmaw finally be at peace.
92065.objectivesText: Bring Varrox Bleakhoof's Head to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
92065.title: Blackmaw Reclamation

92066.description:
When the Legashi invaded, many precious things were left behind in the commotion. Of particular value to me are two totems. They depict legends of our twin gods, Ursoc and Ursol.

I know our immediate survival is of greatest concern, but we must also think of saving our people's history.

Those totems are likely still in our former hold. If they are, you would be doing a great kindness by returning them to me.
92066.objectivesText: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside Blackmaw Hold. Then, return them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.
92066.title: The Twin Bears

92067.description:
You have certainly proven yourself to me, $n, but the others of my tribe are less easily persuaded. For that, you will need to continue your efforts against the Legashi.

Bring to me the horns of slain Legashi satyr. Every bundle you bring me will serve as a symbol of your service to the Blackmaw.
92067.title: Feeding Time!

92069.description:
Two behemoths patrol the place the Blackmaw once called home: Bonesnout, the Unbroken and Withermaw, the great bear. Generations of hunters have tried to fell them, and all have failed.

I take no joy in asking you to slay these magnificent beasts, but my people need to be able to return home. The least I can do is ensure their deaths are not in vain. If you bring me their remains, I will fashion a weapon in memory of their strength.
92069.objectivesText: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc, in Azshara.
92069.title: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

92070.description:
The necklace is adorned with miscellaneous charms: scraps of feathers, acorn shells, and colorful pebbles. Its leather strap is torn. The ornamentation suggests it belonged to a Furbolg, while its small size and rough quality indicate a child's handiwork.

There's a chance the necklace is of some sentimental value to one of the Blackmaw. It may be good to find the owner and return it.
92070.objectivesText: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.
92070.title: A Lost Memento

92094.description:
My brother Fenwick and I recently finished a successful rocket test, the only problem is, he hasn't come back yet! I lost sight of him floating off to the south after his parachute deployed.

It looks like he may have landed in Hyjal!

If you help him find his way out of where he landed, I'm sure he'd find a way to thank you. I'll be grateful to have my brother back!
92094.objectivesText: Wennzut Togglespring lost sight of his brother, Fenwick, floating in his parachute into Hyjal. Look for where he may have ended up.
92094.title: Rocket Gnomes

92100.description:
<A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.>

You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then?

It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years.

<The veteran glances at his surroundings.>

Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.
92100.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's scabbard near Elderwild.
92100.title: Anywhere But Here

92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, $Gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.title: My First Alchemy Set

92111.description:
I see you try, and try is more than most. We give you good will with time, if you do the same.

Enter our den and talk to Osi. She has open paws, will give you more chance to help.
92111.objectivesText: Enter Barkskin Burrow and find the furbolg they call Osi.
92111.title: Of Friend and Fur

92171.description:
To defeat Ve'han,  we require a touch of the sky. A bit of the divine, where one's upward-turned face yearns to fly.

Head to the Shrine of Aviana and seek out Skylord Omnuron. As the leader of the Druids of the Talon, he can assist in adding a touch of Aviana's grace.
92171.objectivesText: Travel to the Shrine of Aviana on Mount Hyjal and seek out Skylord Omnuron for aid.
92171.title: Taking to New Heights

92189.description:
Och, we had to make this village from scratch with what we could scrounge up after the war. All of the fighting has taken a toll on our weapons, not to mention the need for tools!

I can always tell another blacksmith. Think you could spare the time and materials to make me some Dense Sharpening and Dense Grinding Stones? We could really use 'em!
92189.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Dense Sharpening Stones and $2oa Dense Grinding Stones to Trigg Ironhand in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
92189.title: Back to the Grind

92317.description:
So, the hermit druid seeks a force to balance the 'life' in this magic of his? Then the answer is death, naturally. You have come to the right place for such a thing.

No doubt you've seen the undead crawling all over my domain. They are fueled by stolen power that animates them even in death.

That stolen power is exactly what is needed in this spell you speak of. Kill the undead and search through their skulls for a coalesced Drop of Stolen Life. Return it to Ketharas once you have it.
92317.objectivesText: Acquire a Drop of Stolen Life from the Scourge in the ruins on Mount Hyjal, then return to Ketharas.
92317.title: Stolen Life

92328.description:
With the extra supplies you brought back, I have enough materials on hand to finish up Yaely's original plans for this Glaive Thrower. I've been fixing this thing up for the past... well, it feels like forever!

If you can help me out and be a second pair of hands, it'd make this whole project go a lot faster! I can walk you through it, most of the hard stuff should be out of the way... 

<Kaylaena crosses her fingers.>

The driving system and the energy cells powering it are nearly set up.
92328.objectivesText: Turn the two gears and connect the two battery terminals on both sides of Kaylaena's Glaive Thrower.
92328.title: Siegecraft

92343.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt.
92343.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
92343.title: Get to the Roots of It

92344.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the Cenarion Circle would be in your debt.
92344.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
92344.title: Get to the Roots of It

92345.description:
You may have noticed the furbolg and satyr north of here fighting over a burrow. The conflict does not interest me as much as what could be inside. That burrow seems to lead beneath Nordrassil.

I don't think I need to tell you how this could be of interest to the Kaldorei.

We have our hands full here as it is, but the druids of Darnassus should be informed. Find Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave. He can decide if this is something worth pursuing.
92345.objectivesText: Speak to Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
92345.title: Beneath Nordrassil

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92415.description: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415.objectivesText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.title: Remember That I Love You

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92432.completionText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.description:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our leylines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432.objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.title: An Alarming Request

92433.description:
Hey! I'm pretty busy trying to turn these scraps into something edible. You wanna help out? I could really use some more variety for this meal! It sure would be nice to have something different on the menu.

There's a goblin in Everlook who has this recipe for Savory Stag Sliders... perfect for tiny hands like mine. If you could cook up some of those, that would be great! You can get stag meat from the stags here on the mountain.
92433.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Hnaz Blunderflame in Elderwild.
92433.title: Now We're Cooking

92454.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
92454.objectivesText: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
92454.title: Welcome!

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If I have to teach you herbalism you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.

92456.description:
If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.

For a city of mages, Dalaran has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin Tor keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.

You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
92456.objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.
92456.title: A Green Sample

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92458.description:
Whatever disturbed the leylines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.

We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.
92458.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92458.title: Heart of Disruption

92459.description:
The council will not be happy to learn of our subterfuge, but they cannot deny results. The city is calming down, and we are free to lower our wards.

I think it's only fair you deliver the good word. Take this mote to Archmage Celindra within the Violet Citadel.
92459.objectivesText: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
92459.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

92462.description:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.objectivesText: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.title: Infestation Investigation

92466.description:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.objectivesText: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
92466.title: Call of Earth

92468.description: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.$B$BBe patient, $n. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
92468.objectivesText: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
92468.title: Call of Earth

92469.description:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.title: Return to Rorian

92472.description:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.title: The Next Step

92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92479.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479.objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
92479.title: A Scribbled Letter

92484.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.objectivesText: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.title: Embracing the Elements

92489.description:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
92489.title: Power Overwhelming

92500.description:
Since the shrine of Aviana has fallen into disrepair, the Wormwing harpies have snuck in and stolen the last of our druidic relics. One of these, the Jewel of the Horizon, is a sparkling blue stone blessed by the feathered goddess herself. The touch of Aviana may have just the magical power that you need for your task.

The Wormwings have doubtless hidden it in or near one of their nests. When you find it, take it to Ketharas.
92500.objectivesText: Find the Jewel of the Horizon in the Wormwing harpy nests on Mount Hyjal and bring it to Ketharas.
92500.title: A Bit of the Sky

92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.objectivesText: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516.description: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516.objectivesText: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92516.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.title: The Criminal Element

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92529.areaDescription: Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village
92529.description:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529.objectivesText:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
92529.title: Falaath Village

92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.title: The Warrior's Path

92533.description:
I have worked iron my whole life, and I can feel when a weapon has twisted away from its purpose. The Blackthorne cult forges tools meant to wound the land as much as flesh. Slay their cultists and bring me what they carry: one of their staves, and a ritual dagger.

They do not merely kill with their blades, they are poisoning them with intent.

By studying the marks left by their corruption, we can learn how their influence spreads. Perhaps, we will learn how to stop or even reverse it.
92533.objectivesText: Recover a Wicked Ritualist's Kris and a Recoiling Gnarlybark Staff from Blackthorne cultists.
92533.title: Twisted Tools

92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.title: Restocking the Larders

92591.description:
We've tried to escape the mountain, but our attempts have always been thwarted by the Scourge. A powerful lich reanimates the remains of those we destroy and sends them against us again. So long as that lich endures, we'll never be safe.

The lich has a pile of bones from which it rebuilds skeletons. Take this torch and set fire to the bone pile in the ruins. The lich will be sure to respond.

Bring me its amulet, so that we may destroy it and be rid of the lich for good.
92591.objectivesText: Use the Survivor's Torch on the Bone Pile, then collect the Reanimator's Amulet.
92591.title: Final Death

92593.description:
Well, you've shown you're capable enough to handle the busy work. Now we can see if you can be trusted to handle greater threats.

Setting up an intelligence station here is only step one of the job. If you want to help lay the foundations for what's to come, carefully enter Dae'gun, the remains of the Horde base.

Find a high point suitable for an outlook's post. Report back with details about the area, and we'll see about getting you properly briefed.
92593.objectivesText: Enter Dae'gun and locate a high vantage point, then report details to Johun.
92593.title: Avalanche of Corruption

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.> 

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Even for a Shaman, you show particular aptitude in our gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

92595.description:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595.objectivesText: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
92595.title: The Windshapers

92598.description:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

objectives.text: Use Skysight near the Elemental Convergence

92598.objectivesText: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
92598.title: The Gift of Skysight

92612.description:
<Ketharas takes the branch and studies it. He begins to whisper a druidic incantation and the branch begins to glow brighter. The sickly green crystal begins to react as well, seeming to draw in the light surrounding it.>

The secrets this branch holds are regrettably beyond my ability to discern. But I do sense... something.

Take the branch and go to town of Nighthaven in Moonglade. Ask Dendrite Starblaze for assistance.
92612.objectivesText: Travel to Nighthaven, in Moonglade, and ask Dendrite Starblaze for assistance on Ketharas' behalf.
92612.title: Aid from Moonglade

92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.title: Make Yourself Useful

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92698.description:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
92698.title: What Is My Purpose?

92700.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700.title: The Grand Skyseer

92702.description:
<Fenwick struggles to rock back and forth and gain some swaying motion.>

Hey! Hey you! Grab a stick and see if you can reach me, please? I've been stuck here so long my suspenders are chafing! I've got good things--GREAT things--to share with you! Fenwick Togglespring never gives false promises!

It's my rusty brother back at the launch pad who clearly miscalculated a few things in our rocket launch capabilities! He's mister false promises!

<Fenwick fails to grab an object out of reach.>
92702.objectivesText: Locate a sturdy branch capable of reaching Fenwick Togglespring.
92702.title: Branch Out

92703.description:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $n. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703.objectivesText: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
92703.title: Deliver the News

92707.description:
Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.

You should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
92707.objectivesText: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
92707.title: The Giant in the Den

92727.description:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727.objectivesText: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.
92727.title: The Missing Scholar

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92744.description:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744.objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.
92744.title: Murloc Gills

92745.description:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
92745.objectivesText: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
92745.title: The State of the Mines

92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.title: Detonation at a Distance

92753.description:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
92753.objectivesText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
92753.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92814.description:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
92814.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92814.title: I Need a Tailor

92817.description:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92817.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92817.title: Leather Technique

92819.description: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
92819.title: Destruction in Deadmines

92833.description:
Ve'han now claims the Nordrassil Lodge, under the boughs of the great tree, as his lair. It is time for us to put this magic to the ultimate test.

Take the staff and bring it to bear against Ve'han. Dispel the magic protecting him and bring him to justice!
92833.objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain to strip Ve'han Talongrasp of his stolen power, then destroy him.
92833.title: Ve'han's Fall

92841.description:
It is time, outsider, for you to learn of our great discovery... but Warug will not be the one to tell it!

Head south to the other end of the village. Look for a big, stinky centaur named Orgrul.

You will know when you get there.
You will know when you see him.
If he thinks you deserve to know, you will know.

And if he doesn't? Well. You can be happy knowing Warug has a new crown.
92841.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.
92841.title: Valley of Bones

92844.description:
Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul south of the Magram Village in Desolace.
92844.title: Mountain of Bones

92847.description:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Petrified Bark and $2oa Imbued Tears back to Orgrul.
92847.title: Corrupting Tears

92849.description: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

objectives.text: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

92849.title: The Missing Scholar

92860.description:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.title: In Service of Zephras

92871.description:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.title: In Service of Zephras

92872.description:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.

objectives.text: Pouch of Tomb Dust thrown into the sea behind Stromgarde

92872.objectivesText: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
92872.title: Dutiful Steps

92878.description:
<The forsaken points to his missing lower jaw. He then hands you a piece of paper with a hastily scrawled message.>

Can't talk. Lost jaw in fight. Attacked by Grimtotems. Led by a druid. Namida. Camp to northwest.

She must pay.

<The last sentence is underlined twice.>
92878.objectivesText: Bring proof of Namida Grimtotem's demise to Blaise Montgomery at Camp Mojache.
92878.title: Lost for Words

92880.description:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880.objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.title: Return to Valanaar

92894.description:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
92894.title: Bone Raising

92914.description:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>
92914.objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.
92914.title: Strange Pylons

92947.description:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.title: Making Our Move

92960.description:
A lingering demon presence remains to the east. Among them are the hellish beasts responsible for ravaging our kin, siphoning their power to use it against our allies.

Penetrate their camp, locate these beasts and slay them. Retrieve any samples that remain.

Perhaps there is something we can learn from these efforts.
92960.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Ephemeral Essences for Elaena Moonwhisper.
92960.title: Siphoned Ephemeral Essence

93016.description:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.
93016.objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.
93016.title: A Brief History Lesson

93034.description:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $n. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
93034.title: Valley of Bones

93035.description:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, $n.
93035.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay $1oa Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.
93035.title: Ravaging Ravagers

93036.description:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036.objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
93036.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93037.description:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.

I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$n, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring $1oa Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
93037.title: Outing Outcasts

93044.description:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
93044.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93044.title: A Cleansing Cry

93058.description:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

$n, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
93058.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue $1oa Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.
93058.title: Saving Our Own

93066.description:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay quilboar at Bristleback Retreat. Then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front on the other side of Valley of Bones in Desolace.
93066.title: Bristleback Retreat

93122.description:
We have all underestimated the power and presence of the Magram clan in this area, but this could prove an advantage.

With so many of their own distracted and their refusal to accept other clans' exiles, who is left to defend the village? What of their Khan?

I need you to go into the valley, deeper than you have gone before, and look around. If the Magram are as well fortified here as they seem, they may have left themselves vulnerable at their village...
93122.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and investigate centaur points of interest within Shen'dralas. Then return to Nerlokh at the entrance of Valley of Bones with your findings.
93122.title: Checking Things Out

93125.areaDescription: Escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway
93125.description:
You! I saw you outside fighting the outcasts. I know not where you come from, but I need your help.

I was lured here by my Gelkis brethren with an assurance of safety. I knew the war in the Desolace was escalating beyond our control, but I never imagined my own people turning to necromancy in a convoluted bid to defect to the Magram clan. When I spoke out against this, they threatened to kill me if I ever stepped hoof outside this tent!

Please help.
93125.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway. Then inform Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones about what happened.
93125.title: Going Home

93128.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $n, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93159.description:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... it's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?

objectives.text: Learn more about the Strange Hermit

93159.objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
93159.title: The Strange Hermit

93160.description:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor.
