I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
93160.title: The Forest's Bounty

93161.description:
In the faint illumination of your torchlight, you can make out a small glint of metal. Upon further inspection, it's clear that this is the broken hilt of an ancient sword.

Despite missing a blade, you can clearly see that this hilt is a product of masterful workmanship. This is a precious heirloom, and there may be those who are interested to learn more about this.
93161.objectivesText: Find someone who would be interested in the Ancient Hilt you found in the ruins of Ban'aethal.
93161.title: The Ancient Hilt

93165.description:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
93165.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93172.description:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but it's definitely a song and it's... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172.objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.
93172.title: Free the Hollows

93224.description:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
93224.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
93224.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93314.description:
<Jereman shifts her weight, her feathers bristling in anger as she clacks her beak in displeasure.>

I do not know what awaits us here, but there is an overwhelming sense of wrongness about the mountain I have not felt in centuries. Having gotten a taste of the Wild King's magic first-talon however, I know he must be stopped.

I only pray we have arrived in time to save the other Wild Gods who reside here.
93314.objectivesText: Fully explore the Verdant Labyrinth, the Undergrove, and the Southern Peaks areas of Hyjal Summit.
93314.title: The Gods of the Summit

93319.description:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319.objectivesText: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
93319.title: Pilfered Windstones

93320.description:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320.objectivesText: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93320.title: Tower Defense

93383.description:
A sturdy backpack stuffed with survival equipment and radio receivers lies between prickly bushes. There's a flashing indicator light on one of the radios.

You reach for the bag and the radio strapped to the backpack buzzes to life.

"Pilot present! Gnomal Positioning System establishing uplink!

Confirming contents to dispense: Aviator's Survival Kit, Three Day, One Size, Quantity One

Please stand by while security mechanism discharges safely before opening."
93383.objectivesText: Wait until you can safely open the Personal Survival Pack.
93383.title: Contents Under Pressure

93404.description:
I am the ancient. Towering above us. That which still burns despite many rains. I feel its flames in death. Forever burdened by my last mistake.

I do not know why I am cursed to haunt this place. I do not understand why death was not the end.

Please put out the flame. Seek pristine water from a sacred ravine. Such a place exists across Mashan'she. I have heard murmurs of the place in the wind.

Maraudon.
93404.objectivesText: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.
93404.title: Rot and Regret

93406.description:
So you need to bring the return mail back to Mount Hyjal, eh? There's a little problem...

Y'see, someone came through here and ransacked the outgoing mail just a few days ago! Probably looking for money in the mail. Ran off into the hills somewhere north of here and never came back. Probably got torn apart by a yeti or something!

Anyway, if you wanna bring back the mail, you're gonna have to go get it first!
93406.objectivesText: Find $1oa pieces of Missing Mail in the hills north of Everlook and bring it back to Innkeeper Vizzie.
93406.title: Unfrozen Deliveries

93407.description:
We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature.

Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses.
93407.objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.
93407.title: A Thorn in the Paw

93443.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
93443.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
93443.title: Lost Shipping Crate

93444.description:
The most vicious fel chimaera of Hyjal is known as Ghansurok. It likes to swoop in and prey on wildlife caught out of their burrows. Not only that, it's making hippogryph travel in and out of Hyjal more stressful than usual!

First, hunt down one of the Nightsabers hiding in the Summit's shadows. Next, place meat from the fallen cat somewhere on the northern ridge where chimaeras feed.

Lure Ghansurok towards it. Slay the beast and return with its heart. Marn will study it to help heal Hyjal.
93444.objectivesText:
Kill a Nightsaber Guardian, then bait out and kill Ghansurok using the Nightsaber Guardian haunch on the northern ridge of the summit.

Return with the heart of the chimaera.
93444.title: Bait the Beast

93450.description:
Being corporeal has its challenges, as you know, but being INcorporeal is a whole other situation. Will I fall through THIS chair? Will I trip over THAT cat? Worst of all, however, it makes everyday work impossible!

Do you see this sword on my anvil? I began work on this thousands of years ago, but met my demise before it was finished. Now it taunts me, AND takes up precious real estate! I cannot work with it! I cannot MOVE it!

I need you to help, uh, "ferry" it to the spirit realm. What do you say?
93450.objectivesText: Take Vindael's unfinished sword and figure out a way to usher it into the spirit realm, then return the Phantasmal Blade to him at Shen'dralas.
93450.title: Phantasmal Problems

93451.description:
Ah, you look to be a sensible individual. Likely more sense than the last oaf that passed by. I need a small favor of you.

You see, I had a problem. My greatest masterpiece of swordsmithing was left unfinished before my passing, and I needed someone to assist in bringing it into the spirit world so that I may finish it. The last person was gracious enough to help, and they succeeded!

Now I have a new problem. Through every fault of his own, the previous adventurer can no longer bring it back to me.
93451.objectivesText: Locate Vindael's unfinished sword and return it to him in Shen'dralas.
93451.title: Phantasmal Problems

93464.description:
Allow me to admit something, $n. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands. 

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, $r. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
93464.objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
93464.title: The Visiting Mage

93465.description:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
93465.objectivesText: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.
93465.title: Notes on Draenethyst

93547.description:
We are constantly under threat here, both by the Blackthorne Pact and by the hostile creatures of Hyjal. But we can use the thorns to our advantage! With a little help from the power of nature, we can grow new thorn bushes to help protect our enclosure.

Plant thorn seeds near the road to help create barricades by the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees near the road.

objectives.text: Thorn seed planted near storage tower
Thorn seed planted near group of trees

93547.objectivesText: Plant thorn seeds near the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees at the loyalist druid camp.
93547.title: A Thorny Solution

93552.description:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552.objectivesText: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
93552.title: Harvesting Windstones

93585.areaDescription: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage
93585.description:
Oh thank goodness, someone civilized!

I came here on behalf of the Church of the Holy Light to make contact with the draenei of the Harborage. The Alliance has no foothold here, you see, and a bit of diplomacy with the locals may help us in that regard. The Light welcomes all into its fold, after all!

However, the road past this bridge is crawling with the draenei's more savage kin. If I am to make it to the Harborage safely, I will need protection. Would you aid me, $c?
93585.objectivesText: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.
93585.title: This Light of Mine

93594.description:
Among the treants borne of the necklace, one in particular stood above all the others to have received the gift of life and sentience. I suspect if they have fallen, he may be the only one that remains.

He spent his days tending to each and every bloom and bud, and his evenings rooted in the ground to serve as a nest for the smaller critters.

If he is alive, and I pray that to be true, then he may know what happened.

I am holding out hope for my good friend, Woodwyrd.
93594.objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.
93594.title: Word of the Woods

93604.description:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.
93604.objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.
93604.title: Agamaggan's Blood

93644.description:
<Found near Shen'dralas, this dirty old tome no longer holds most of its knowledge.

Of the text that remains, individual letters are difficult to distinguish from words. It may prove challenging to read at first, but one of them appears to be a surname.

Perhaps its author, "Evenshade", may be found nearby.>
93644.objectivesText: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.
93644.title: Tattered Journal

93663.description:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
93663.title: Lost in Transit

93678.description:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.

While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
93678.objectivesText: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.
93678.title: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst

93680.description:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.title: Key to the City

93685.description:
Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, $r? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, $r... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
93685.objectivesText:
Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.

Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
93685.title: To Serve Kum'isha

93689.description:
This is excellent news! With Dalaran returned to peace, I can see no reason the Kirin Tor would not welcome you with open arms!

Please, report to the council with great haste. I'm sure they will be looking forward to meeting the city's savior.
93689.objectivesText: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.
93689.title: Friend of the Kirin Tor

93736.description:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736.objectivesText: Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
93736.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93739.description:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739.objectivesText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
93739.title: Exploring the Horde

93740.description:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
93740.title: Blood for Blood

93746.description:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
93746.objectivesText: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
93746.title: A Firm Response

93791.description:
$n, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791.objectivesText: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.
93791.title: Speak with Belann

93825.description:
You wish to learn from us? The trees of Hyjal speak to us. Their bark holds life, and on it grows the moss we call Moonveil. It is soft, green, and strong with the mountain's soul. We need this moss to heal our hurt and bless roots.

Go, gentle one. Seek the old trees where the mist clings and the sun hides. Take Moonveil moss from their bark and bring it back to me. With it, we will mend what pains us.
93825.objectivesText: Gather $1oa clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.
93825.title: Barkbound Blessings

93827.description:
The mountain winds bring dark signs. Harpies nest high where our paws do not go. The gems they wear hold strong power. Bound with our charms, they guard us from curse and bind the spirits to our wards.

But the climb is hard, and the harpies strike with claw and storm. If you are strong like they say, go to the high crags where the wind screams. Harpy grounds are in mid land Hyjal, we see them fly above us, in the north east. Take the charms from the sky witches and bring them to me.
93827.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Enchanted Harpy Amulet and return to Thobon Sapclaw.
93827.title: Windswept Wards

93832.description:
High slopes hold stone wings. Rock-beasts. Half-live, half-dead. Foul hands carve them. Do not trust their still pose. These eyes wait for one wrong step.

Our young do not know the risk. One paw too near, and stone wakes with claw and fang.

Go, smash these cursed forms. Break their wings, crush their shards, and let the mountain breathe free.
93832.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Eternal Sentry gargoyles in the destroyed Alliance base in upper Hyjal and return to Elder Mistpaw.
93832.title: Shatter the Stonewatchers

93926.description:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge; let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!

objectives.text: Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands

93926.objectivesText: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
93926.title: The Western Watch

93948.description:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948.objectivesText: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
93948.title: Deliver the Signet

93958.description:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
93958.title: The Inner Sanctum

93963.description:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
93963.title: Exploring the Alliance

94003.description:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94004.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength

94006.description:
Greetings, $n. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.objectivesText: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
94006.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94373.description:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.objectivesText: Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94373.title: Call of Earth

94375.description:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $n. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.objectivesText: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
94375.title: Call of Earth

94411.description:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
94411.objectivesText: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
94411.title: Meddlesome Mages

94414.description:
Greetings, young $n. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.objectivesText: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
94414.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94427.description:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.objectivesText: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
94427.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94435.description: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.
94435.objectivesText: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94436.areaDescription: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Tyr's Watch.
94436.completionText: Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94436.description:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.objectivesText:
Speak with Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438.areaDescription: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.completionText: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
94438.description:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.objectivesText:
Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale. 

Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440.description:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.objectivesText: Retrieve the Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans from the Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale, and return to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.
94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94465.description:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame. 

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
94465.title: Call of Fire

94468.description: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.$B$BYou start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Bruegs Kindleborn in Dun Morogh.
94468.title: Call of Fire

94483.description:
Our scouts have reported training camps by the river to the south. If I'd received word sooner, it would have saved us both the hassle of locating and removing the human filth in a timely manner.

Continue your efforts, $n. Holding back the humans to their precious little keep will buy us time to focus on other matters at hand.

Be swift about it.
94483.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Farholde Priests and $2oa Farholde Scouts south of the river.
94483.title: Show Them How It's Done

94486.description:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.objectivesText: Collect $1oa feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
94486.title: Feathers for Binding

94487.description:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
94487.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94491.description:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $n. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.objectivesText: Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
94491.title: The Fate of the Den

94493.description:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straits indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.objectivesText: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
94493.title: A Sacrifice in Vain

94494.description:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, $n. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, $n.
94494.objectivesText: Find Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94494.title: Call of Water

94495.description:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.objectivesText: Find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94495.title: Call of Water

94499.description:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.objectivesText: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94499.title: Call of Water

94500.description:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine. It stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.objectivesText: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
94500.title: Call of Water

94502.description:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.objectivesText:
Drink the Water Sapta and Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.title: Call of Water

94503.description: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.objectivesText: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Westfall.
94503.title: Call of Water

94505.description: Take shard. Take shard and give life.$B$BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.$B$BYou protect and give life with water's power.
94505.objectivesText: Bring the Shard of Water to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.
94505.title: Call of Water

94535.description:
Our allies mining ore from the hills to the south reported several attacks by gnolls in the area.

Travel south, locate their camps and retrieve the stolen ore. Take it from their dead bodies if need be.
94535.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Stolen Ore from gnolls in the Bristle Hills for Kreza Darkthorn.
94535.title: Bristle Hills Bandits

94556.description: Jom-jom came looking for friend. Now Jom-jom want to go home.
94556.objectivesText: Escort Jom-jom to Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
94556.title: Jom-jom's Escape

94568.description:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

objectives.text: Learn what you can from the crystal

94568.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
94568.title: The Cult's True Plans

94613.description:
Our warhorses come from two nearby farms. One of them, owned by the Wheeler family off the road just outside of town, has apparently lost all of their stock. The cause of this is currently unknown.

With no horses, we have no cavalry, and without cavalry, our campaign against the Horde stands no chance.

Thus, you see, this situation must be resolved with utmost haste. Of where to start, however, I am less sure.

Go to Wheeler's Grange and speak to Benjy. See what he has to say for himself.
94613.objectivesText: Go to Wheeler's Grange to inquire about the missing horses.
94613.title: My Kingdom for a Horse

94614.description:
You seen those murlocs down by the river, just west of here? Nasty things. Bad for my animals, and bad for the wildlife. Not to mention, they've settled right on top of my favorite fishing spot!

There ain't a soul in the Riverglades who wouldn't appreciate you getting rid of a few, that's for sure. 

Please, kill any you see. You'd be doin' us a whole heap of good.
94614.objectivesText: Kill 8 Mudfin Oracles and 8 Mudfin Warriors along the river near Wheeler's Grange.
94614.title: Freshwater Fiends

94615.description:
I've got no idea what happened to our horses. I got up one morning to feed 'em and they were all gone, just like that.

Life outside Farholde's a bit rougher. Anything could've got 'em--animals, murlocs, orcs, you name it.

If we wanna narrow down our list of culprits, we oughta search around the stables for clues.
94615.objectivesText: Search near the stables at Wheeler's Grange for evidence of the missing horses' whereabouts.
94615.title: Foal Play

94617.description:
There's a pack of coyotes livin' in a den west of here. We can see 'em sometimes from across the river. They used to hunt fish on the shore, but I guess the murlocs pushed 'em out of their usual feeding ground, and so they've taken to eating horses.

The leader of the coyote pack's a bigger one with dark fur. We'd nicknamed him "Sootfur". I reckon if you kill him, the rest'll scatter.
94617.objectivesText: Kill the coyote known as Sootfur, and bring its pelt back to Benjy Wheeler.
94617.title: Coyote Huntin'

94618.description:
From what you found, it seems like the coyotes got most of the horses. Still, there's a few not accounted for.

Those that didn't get eaten probably ran off scared someplace. I don't know how many of those horses there are, but we'd better find 'em before the coyotes come back.

<Benjy holds out a sack in front of you.>

Here. If you find one, give it some of our feed. That'll get it to trust you so you can lead it back here.
94618.objectivesText: Find one of the horses that fled Wheeler's Grange after the coyote attack and give it some feed.
94618.title: Wheeler's Fleeing Steeds

94638.description:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638.objectivesText: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
94638.title: Strength and Mercy

94668.description:
You smashed weak Twilight ogres. But they weak.

Today you show Bloodmaster and little goblin friend you belong.

Tomorrow, maybe we meet again if you still breathing.
94668.objectivesText: Report to Jezap at the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94668.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94670.description:
The battle of the Bloodmaster's Ring begins!

We'll start you off easy here, pal. This flighty fiend'll take you down, then pick ya clean.

Now quit standin' around and step into the ring. Fame awaits!
94670.objectivesText: Defeat Buzzbeak in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94670.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94678.description:
The gnolls have been a thorn in our side ever since we arrived. While less a threat than the Twilight's Hammer, they are aggressive, persistent and, worst of all, numerous.

The hills beyond this post are infested with them, making passage to the north dangerous, and posing a threat to those living outside the walls of Farholde Keep.

If we are ever to make these lands safe, removing the gnoll threat is imperative.
94678.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Redridge Mystics, $2oa Redridge Trappers, and $3oa Redridge Brutes for Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94678.title: Gnoll Infestation

94679.description:
Gnolls value strength above all else. By killing their strongest, we not only lessen the threat they pose physically, but also strike fear into their hearts.

In a den among the Bristle Hills is a notorious gnoll by the name of Snargl. His death would no doubt sow panic among the Redridge's ranks.

Bring me his snout, and be quick about it.
94679.objectivesText: Locate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and bring his snout to Cedric Dalton at Southern Watch.
94679.title: Snargl's Snout

94734.description:
Gobam know Chub'chob pet love to eat food. Specially good food!

Yum yum berry and plant from river make good treat for Snufflesnout. Berry sweet. Best berry from human farm near ocean.

You find. Bring back. Me help make big treat.
94734.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Sweetberry and $2oa Riverweed for Gobam.
94734.title: A Boar's Delight

94737.description:
Ok friend. Here is treat. Snufflesnout snort and be happy when she see this.

And tell goblin please stop talk so much.
94737.objectivesText: Deliver the bundle of goods to Jezap Jinglesprocket in Bolder'ok.
94737.title: A Treat for a Friend

94739.description:
Glad you made it through the first round, I guess.

This next contestant and I go way back. He ain't the brightest fella, but he's sure good at pummeling anything in his path.

Just head on into the pit and get yourself ready while I make the announcement.
94739.objectivesText: Defeat Kronk in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94739.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94745.description:
Do you see the fortress just west of here? The Twilight's Shroud, they call it. Filled to the brim with Twilight's Hammer cowards.

They may have walls and numbers, but their pitiful reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak. Show them how vulnerable they really are!
94745.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Fanatics, $2oa Twilight Corrupters, and $3oa Twilight Champions within the Twilight's Shroud for Da'grosh.
94745.title: Carving a Path

94774.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $n. They've asked you to travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94774.title: Divine Grace

94775.description: Elune bless you, good $r. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day.$B$BOne of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.
94775.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94775.title: Divine Grace

94779.description: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, $n.$B$BAbout this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also.$B$BWhen your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.
94779.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
94779.title: Divine Grace

94792.description:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94792.title: Taming the Beast

94819.description: $n, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94819.title: Contingency Plan

94820.description: Your race is so very clever, $n. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you.$B$BWord came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.
94820.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94820.title: Contingency Plan

94822.description: You've caught the attention of our superiors, $n. They've asked you to travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94822.title: Confounding Flash

94824.description: Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, $n. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.$B$BBut don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.objectivesText: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
94824.title: Confounding Flash

94832.description:
Unfortunately I haven't had much luck with identifying the ring's owner to bring closure to their family.

Perhaps Daythor can be of assistance. He knew the others of our regiment quite well.

I only hope it does not bring back unpleasant memories...
94832.objectivesText: Show the ring to Daythor Brellan.
94832.title: Belle's Ring

94841.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94841.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94841.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94842.description:
We make our own fertilizer out here. It's a special formula of mine that reeks like hell, but grows trees like they're weeds.

It's a 1:1:2 ratio of crawfish shells, manure, and murloc heads. Tasty, right?

The manure's easy enough. We've got the ranch to the south for that. The heads and shells? Those you're going to have to go wading in the river for.

If you feel like lending a hand, we could sure use your help getting some fertilizer ingredients.
94842.objectivesText: Gather 4 Jumbo Crawfish Shells, 4 pieces of Fresh Manure, and 8 Mudfin Murloc Heads for Halligan Turner.
94842.title: Unsavory Plant Food

94857.description:
Stranger, listen to me!

I work as a lumberjack for the nearby logging camp. As you can see, I've been trapped here in an accident. If I don't get out from here soon, I'll either bleed out, or be eaten by wild animals.

Please, go to the logging camp and fetch help!
94857.objectivesText: Go to Turner's Logging Camp and get help.
94857.title: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...

94858.description:
There was one more thing I wanted to talk to you about, friend.

When the Twilight's Hammer attacked, I put everyone who couldn't defend themselves in the barn to hide. I thought they would be safe. I thought...

<Elbrim's voice cracks as he recounts what happened.>

If you could do me one last kindness, will you go see what's left of my family? They should be buried here at home with me. I just don't have the heart to check myself.
94858.objectivesText: Find Farmer Elbrim's family's possessions in the nearby barn and return them to him.
94858.title: All That's Left

94877.description:
When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people.

Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families.

Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands.
94877.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders, $2oa Twilight Shadowmancers, and $3oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
94877.title: Saving Sunnyglade

94879.description:
You've seen the ruined city to the north, yes? Sunnyglade? Demar tries sending troops, but we're no closer to reclaiming it. I have a better idea.

In truth, this attack by the Twilight's Hammer is not the first. They seem to be coordinating from a centralized location, and I would know where. While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.
94879.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twilight Pages from within Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberall in Farholde Keep.
94879.title: Scraps of Knowledge

94881.description:
My, what have we here? A brave new $c come to save us from our woes? How charming! Maybe you can help me with something then? I'd quite like to learn more about this cult in Sunnyglade.

Like any cult, they operate in a caste system. Those with an affinity for magic are often in high favor and are given tokens to demonstrate such. These charms are then imbued, and thus have a rich abundance of cultist magic.

I wish to see these tokens for myself. Be a dear and see if you can bring me a few, hmm?
94881.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Twilight Charms from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94881.title: Curious Trinkets

94884.description:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
94884.objectivesText: Bring the Filled Crystal Catalyst to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94884.title: An Unsettling Discovery

94885.description:
The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. 

The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements.

Someone in Farholde will want to see this.
94885.objectivesText: Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94885.title: Field Marshal's Log

94886.completionText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.description:
As helpful as you've been here in Farholde, I believe your talents could be put to better use elsewhere.

A patrol of ours went missing some time ago. They were in charge of our western borders, but with the information Miss Amberhall has uncovered, I fear they walked right into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.

We can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade ourselves. If the good lady is right, it's critical that we check on our wayward sergeant. He could use all the help he can get.
94886.objectivesText: Find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
94886.title: The Western Front

94887.description:
Field Marshal Ryan is one of our best. His keen eyes and reliable intel have been paramount to our war efforts.

His final reports refer to a Twilight's Hammer fortress to the west. Find him before it's too late. And take his logbook with you. It may offer more clues as to the whereabouts of our missing marshal.
94887.objectivesText: Find Marshal Ryan within the Twilight's Shroud.
94887.title: Saving Marshal Ryan

94891.description:
Seems like things are quieting down around here for now, but I want to keep an eye out. You want to send Amberhall a report? Send her this.

<Sergeant Riftan tosses Kilgar's head back to you.>

That ought to shut her up. At least for a while. Good work out there.
94891.objectivesText: Return to Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94891.title: News to Farholde

94893.completionText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Terry Lawrence in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.description:
So, his final thoughts were of Abigail?

I know this is not your business, friend, but I must ask you to deliver the news of the Marshal's passing on my behalf. Ryan's betrothed, Abigail Lawson, did not join us when we established Farholde Keep. The two of them apparently had a disagreement, and while I do not know the specifics, I do know that she now resides within Stormwind City.

Please take the Marshal's crest to Terry for me. I don't think my presence would be a welcome one.
94893.objectivesText: Deliver Marshal Ryan's Crest to Abigail Lawson in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City.
94893.title: Delivering Closure

94894.completionText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.description:
Lady Amberhall told me of your exploits with the Twilight's Hammer. I'm impressed. But concerned.

Farholde started its campaign originally to remove the Horde from our homeland. While that remains our primary goal, we cannot take this sudden surge in cultist activity lightly. If our pleas to Stormwind remain unheard, we will be overwhelmed as we face foes on two fronts alone.

With the evidence you carry, perhaps they can set aside their pride long enough to listen. At this point it's our only option.
94894.objectivesText: Deliver Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon within Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
94894.title: The Twilight Threat

94895.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94895.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94895.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94907.description:
You've been such a good little $c for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.
94907.objectivesText: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
94907.title: A Small Favor

94912.description:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.objectivesText: Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.
94912.title: Child of Nature

94924.description:
The orcish poachers are a bloodthirsty lot. They'll kill anything that moves--be it men, lions, or horses. They are a threat to all life in the Riverglades, and must be stopped.

They roam the plains in packs, like rabid animals. If you see any, put them down.
94924.objectivesText: Kill 12 Rog'mar Poachers for Watcher Cornelius.
94924.title: Hunting the Hunters

94925.description:
Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade.

We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions.

Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.
94925.objectivesText: Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral.
94925.title: A Fur Trade

94926.description:
Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all.

To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise.
94926.objectivesText: Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise.
94926.title: Drop the Hammer

94927.areaDescription: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok
94927.description:
When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight.

Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man.
94927.objectivesText: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok then return to Watcher Cornelius.
94927.title: Dunston Checks Out

94928.description:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
94928.objectivesText: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
94928.title: A Few Furs for Friz

94929.description:
I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. It's a shipment of utmost urgency.

An old acquaintance resides in a keep within the Riverglades. To get there, travel northeast through the bogs avoiding the deadly creatures within. Along the northeastern hillside sits an old path. Travel its road all the way through the hills and when you hit the fork in the road stay north, then east. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore.

I thank you for your aid.
94929.objectivesText: Bring the Shipment to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.
94929.title: Deliver the Second Shipment

94930.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94930.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94930.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94931.description:
The boys up at Southern Watch do a good job keeping gnolls out for the most part. Every now and then a few sneak into the camp at night and cause a bit of trouble. They especially like to steal saw blades, which they likely use to make weapons out of the sharp metal.

If you could get some back for us, it'd be a big help. The gnolls have probably got 'em stashed away somewhere in their camps up in the hills to the west.
94931.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Saw Blades from the gnoll camps in Bristle Hills for Halligan Turner at the lumber mill.
94931.title: Stolen Saws

94946.description:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.objectivesText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94961.description:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!
94961.objectivesText: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.
94961.title: Biting the Hand

94962.description:
Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what?

You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget.

Hope you're ready for a surprise.
94962.objectivesText: Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94962.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94963.description:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.
94963.title: Biting the Hand

94968.description:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.
94968.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.
94968.title: Eye of Mugg

94969.description:
Don't ask. You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

Let's just focus on getting me out of here! Oh, and you as well, of course.
94969.title: Krol'dok No More!

94971.description:
One of the most important parts of a paladin's arsenal has always been their warhorse. These specially consecrated animals bear paladins and their arms into battle, and are as fearless and bold as the best of us.

While our situation has changed, our need for steeds to bear us into battle has not. It's time that you had such a mount for yourself.
94971.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr to learn to summon your Warhorse.
94971.title: A Paladin's Steed

94972.description:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.
94972.objectivesText: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
94972.title: Tome of Twilight

94973.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94973.objectivesText: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.
94973.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94974.description:
The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key.

It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.
94974.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bar to Kreza Darkthorn.
94974.title: Key Ingredients

94975.description:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.
94975.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94975.title: A Token of Vengeance

94979.description:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.objectivesText:
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. 
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
94979.title: Taming the Beast

94980.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94980.objectivesText: Find someone in Farholde Keep who may know about the mould.
94980.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94981.description:
The moulding is rather crude, but we may be able to fashion a key with the right materials.

I'll keep the embers running hot while you gather the necessary components.
94981.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bars to Alphonse Dumas.
94981.title: Key Ingredients

94982.description:
Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost.

Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness.

Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.
94982.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Commander Brant with proof of their leader's demise.
94982.title: Eye of Mugg

94983.description:
The stories our scouts shared were quite horrid. I'll spare you the gruesome details. What we've discovered confirms previous reports of a cultist hideout.

To the north lies a cave, well hidden by its surroundings. This cave leads to... well, a place we've yet to infiltrate. We believe it's a foothold, nestled deep within the mountains.

It's time we repay the cultists for their actions against our allies.

Venture north, seek out our enemies, and return to me with proof of their demise.
94983.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Bangles from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94983.title: Twilight Mementos

94984.description:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
94984.objectivesText: Kill Nar'gurk within Krol'dok Stronghold and recover any valuable information.
94984.title: Tome of Twilight

94992.areaDescription: Escort the lost horse to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.description: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.>
94992.objectivesText: Bring the lost horse back to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.title: Rescue Roundup

94998.description:
Quite simple to dispel, really. Remnants of something, that's for sure. What, exactly, I do not know.

Well, I'm afraid I've done all that I can. I'm sorry if you were expecting more from me, but... on second thought, the craftsmanship of these is quite unique. Perhaps they could be of some use.

Take these to Melanie Sable. Tell her I sent you. Let her know they're safe.

She may have some use for them just yet.
94998.objectivesText: Bring the Satchel of Mementos to Melanie Sable.
94998.title: Curios of Curiosity

95027.description:
We always need more arrows for hunting and fighting, and for feathers, we use the white feathers of the Hyjal owl. They're naturally fluffy and soft, but I stiffen them up with a mixture designed to make them perfect for fletching.

You can get feathers from the owls, of course, but they also leave behind feathers in their nests, which you can find all over to the south of here.

Bring back a bundle of feathers, all right?
95027.objectivesText: Head south into the valley and collect owl feathers from their nests.
95027.title: Feathers in Flight

95033.description:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.
95033.objectivesText: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
95033.title: On the Other Side

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95059.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Knight Commander Demar Brant at Farholde is waiting for this. For some reason he always makes me say his full name. What an odd fella.

Anywho, you can find him holed up in the keep southwest of here. Massive stone fortress. Ya can't miss it.
95059.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95059.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95107.description:
One chief of the Deadwood, Deeproar, barks in the depths of their den. He was once of no burrow, and in a night of bad blood, he fell sway to their spells.

Now, he feeds on their sour sap, with twice the cursed roar.

Go. End his foul ways. Take his staff and bring it here, so I know he holds it no more.
95107.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Deeproar and return his staff to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow.
95107.title: Deeproar Down

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95125.description:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectivesText: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95140.description:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectivesText: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.
