Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95143.description:
I've been watching you, $n. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani.

He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible.

Think you can locate him for me?
95143.objectivesText: Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades.
95143.title: Finding Tan'jani

95144.description:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!
95144.objectivesText: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95144.title: Overseas Delivery

95147.description:
You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

<Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.>

Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead.

I hate these damn hills!
95147.objectivesText: Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch.
95147.title: The Lost Scout

95148.description:
As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody.

Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.
95148.objectivesText: Deliver the Southern Watch Gnoll Report to the knight commander at Farholde Keep.
95148.title: Southern Watch Gnoll Report

95156.description:
Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle.

If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with.

I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.
95156.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds.
95156.title: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em

95162.description:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.
95162.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.
95162.title: Paletusk Harvesting

95184.description:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
95184.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Solid Sharpening Stones to Ember Bladewhisper at the Farholde training grounds.
95184.title: The Sharpest of Blades

95189.completionText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.objectivesText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195.description: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
95195.title: Bloodied Insignia

95198.description:
Take this. It's a handy bit o' glamour that the mages back home put together to make a quick disguise. It'll make you look like a Kul Tiras Marine which should do nicely for this mission.

Sneak in to the tower and do yer best to listen for any mention of the man that washed up on the beach. I warn you though, do not get too close to Jaina. She will see right through this disguise. 

Come back and see me if you lose your disguise, I'll set you up with a new one.
95198.objectivesText: Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop on Jaina and her inner circle at the Theramore Mage Tower.
95198.title: The Return of the King?

95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.objectivesText: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectivesText: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectivesText: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.title: The New Plague

95217.description:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.objectivesText: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.
95217.title: The Quarry's Smith

95218.description:
The Light has forsaken me. A purpose served, and now everything... gone...

It's just a matter of time until the light turns to darkness.

I fought against the demons and scourge forces with a ferocity I did not know the Light could produce... and yet, I sit here, talking to you, feeling... well, I can't quite put it into words. Some reclaim their purpose after loss, yet I struggle... After all, I am only who I am.

Now, unless the commander has one last call to action, I await what comes next.
95218.title: More of the Same

95219.description:
Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world?

This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot.

One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?
95219.objectivesText: Deliver the Cask of Powderfuse Port to Mardrack Greenwell at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
95219.title: From Port to Port

95248.description:
You cut down so many of da Scourge dat we finally have a little safety. For dat, we be thankful.

One more thing. We know dat there are druids at da summit. Dey protect da great tree and da well.

How come dey never helped us?

We been here five years! Why did dey never even send a message to anyone about us? Let someone know dat we still here, we still alive!
95248.objectivesText: Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.
95248.title: To the Summit of Eternity

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Ah, a fellow human. It's about time Lordaeron sent reinforcements.

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I don't dare trust this task to any of these filthy half breeds, but if I could impose on you a favor, I beg of you to find me the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

95250.description:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250.objectivesText: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
95250.title: Abominable Creatures

95262.description:
Can't say I've ever thought much about Alcaz. Near as I can tell, it's an abandoned outpost from the third war of little significance. Never heard nuthin' about a prison there. 

Well, there's nothing for it--we've got to get you in there and see what you can see, especially if there's a chance that the king is there.

objectives.text: Learn what became of Varian Wrynn

95262.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind.
95262.title: The Secret Prison

95263.description: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. This is devastating news and will shake Stormwind to its core. You need to return to Sully and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>
95263.objectivesText: Return to Sully McCleary in Dustwallow Marsh.
95263.title: Somber News

95283.description:
Lok-tar, $n. I find myself in need of assistance with a serious matter. 

Some time ago we dispatched a contingent of Kor'kron Elite to Dustwallow Marsh on a special mission. The problem is, we are far past their scheduled check-in with no word from them.

Head down to Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh and speak with an orc named Nazeer Bloodspike. No one is more knowledgeable about the state of Dustwallow than he. Find out what you can.
95283.objectivesText: Speak with Nazeer Bloodspike in Brackenwall Village.
95283.title: The Missing Kor'kron

95293.description:
Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people.

Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.
95293.objectivesText: Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore.
95293.title: Smuggler's Special

95294.description:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
95294.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95294.title: Smuggler's Bargain

95295.description:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.
95295.objectivesText: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.
95295.title: I Know a Guy

95296.completionText: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris
95296.description:
Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy.

All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port.

Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out.
95296.objectivesText: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
95296.title: Shipping and Handling

95309.description:
Your orders are simple-- Go into the dungeons beneath the keep and find Commander Folkar. Free him if he lives, and learn what you can about what in the twisting nether is going on here.

There's an army waiting for you down there and you won't survive on your own. I hope you have allies... preferably strong ones.
95309.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and find Commander Folkar.
95309.title: No Orc Left Behind

95312.completionText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan
95312.description:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.
95312.objectivesText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.
95312.title: Coming to Collect

95316.description:
Alright dirtwalker, you may have noticed the combination of pinecones and fel-infused slime is quite disgusting, if you ask me. It is, however, also very dangerous-- which is just what we need!

Take these pinecones and carefully--I repeat, carefully--make your way to the nearby warlock encampment. Once there, use these items to wreak havoc upon their precious workstations.

I am sure the results will be amusing for you to watch firsthand! This should certainly slow them down.
95316.objectivesText: Use the pinecones to destroy the Ashen Reign workstations.
95316.title: The Experimental Method

95319.description:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
95319.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Crystals and $2oa Pristine Fel-Slime Crystal.
95319.title: Crystalline Collection

95321.description:
Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper.

It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.
95321.objectivesText: Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
95321.title: Tazzik's Dues

95322.description:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?
95322.objectivesText: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
95322.title: Get the Goods

95325.description:
I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it!

You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, $n. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money.
95325.objectivesText: Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn.
95325.title: We've Been Robbed!

95327.description:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.
95327.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95327.title: All's Well That Ends Well

95329.description:
There is a watch tower overlooking the plains to the north. It serves as an observation point to track any motion of the Horde's forces.

The watcher stationed there is named Cornelius. Speak to him and get a status report. He is all alone out there, so I like to check on him with some regularity. Fair warning, he can be a bit...taciturn. It's why he was assigned such a remote post in the first place.
95329.objectivesText: Go to Terral's Watch to get a status report from Watcher Cornelius.
95329.title: Out in the Field

95330.description:
My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say.

There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet.

If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.
95330.objectivesText: Deliver Cassandra's surplus farm goods to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp.
95330.title: Love Thy Neighbor

95379.description:
Brashann Grimdark, Master of Vessels.

<Felflick's mouth curls into a snarl.>

He was the one to subjugate me at the summit. HE is the reason I am here in the first place.

His work with these fel-ash crystals are the backbone of this operation. He's been obsessively experimenting with anchoring souls in these crystals and his work has not gone unnoticed by those Blackthorne creeps.

Use this pristine crystal to drain his power, then put an end to him and bring me his soulstone.
95379.objectivesText: Slay Brashann Grimdark and search his body for his soulstone.
95379.title: A Revenge So Sweet

95424.description:
Here ogres value strength and blood.

Weak ones leave Bolder'ok. Go back to Twilight's Hammer.

You no big. Maybe you strong. Show Clugfist strength and smash weak ogres. If tiny creature can.
95424.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Maulers and $2oa Twilight Firecallers for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
95424.title: Might Makes Right

95433.description:
When Clugfist leave Twilight, one ogre stand in way. Morg.

Morg massive ogre. Nearly as massive as Clugfist. But not massivest. He need tinies to protect him. Clugfist never got fair fight. Now WE no fight fair.

Find Morg. Bring many tinies with you. Kill him. Take mace back to Clugfist. Then Twilight know they challenge us no more!
95433.objectivesText: Collect the Executioner's Mace from Executioner Morg in the Twilight Shroud for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
95433.title: Death to the Executioner

95454.description:
My good axe arm is broken and most of my elites are dead. The honor of the Kor'kron rests with you now.

We were sent here to extract a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... We are here for the King of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. We intercepted information that he was being held here and our Warchief commanded us to bring him back to Orgrimmar alive. The presence of black dragons... complicates things.

I need you to press on and find Wrynn. I will wait for you here while you search for him.

objectives.text: Read the note on the ground

95454.objectivesText: Look for King Varian Wrynn in Alcaz Prison.
95454.title: The Honor of the Kor'kron

95472.description:
I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back!

Why are you lookin' at me like that...
95472.objectivesText: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95472.title: Consolation Prize

95483.description:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.
95483.objectivesText: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
95483.title: Thrall Needs to Know

95494.description:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectivesText: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95534.description:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >

objectives.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

95534.objectivesText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95562.description:
I have a confession to make. Lady Amberhall did send me to collect those samples, but in truth I volunteered. Sunnyglade was my home before the war took it from me, and I could not rest knowing monsters still taint it. Be it horde or Twilight.

There is no victory here by learning from them. There's nothing to learn. They're beasts, plain and simple, and should be put down like beasts.

We must slay their master at the bottom of this cave and bring an end to this. Surely my mistress will understand.
95562.objectivesText: Kill Chogg'Zac in the caves beneath Sunnyglade and retrieve their heads for Apprentice Claire.
95562.title: Cut Off the Heads

95569.description:
The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young.

For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.
95569.objectivesText: Rescue $1oa Hyjal Owl Eggs and bring them to Ketharas.
95569.title: Hope for Hatchlings

95602.description:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.
95602.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95602.title: Sickening Lights

95603.description:
Since brother Lowley and I began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity, the church here has fallen into disuse. I'd like to think that once the fighting is over, we will be able to bring the Light back to this place. Although, I fear that may not be for a long while...

Still, we need to keep the church in working order, in the hope that day will come.

To that end, a colony of bats has taken to roosting in the upper stories of the church. It would be a great help if you could remove them.
95603.objectivesText: Kill 5 Roosting Duskbats in the Farholde Cathedral for Sister Rowland.
95603.title: Bats in the Belfry

95613.description:
While we no longer hold service at the church, I feel it important to keep the candles lit on the graves of our fallen in the church's crypt. To me, keeping the candle's flame alive is a symbol that they are not forgotten and their sacrifices were not in vain.

If you would, bring me candles so that I might continue this ritual. It would mean a great deal to me.

If you're not sure where to find them, speak with Marla in the house just outside of the church. She's a friend and may have some to spare.
95613.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Holy Candles to Sister Rowland in Farholde Keep.
95613.title: Keeping the Light On

95615.description:
If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out.

Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place.
95615.objectivesText: Place $1oa Memorial Candles on graves in the chapel graveyard for Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep.
95615.title: In Memoriam

95621.description:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

objectives.text: Learn why the Kul Tirans are here

95621.objectivesText: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
95621.title: Trouble in the Valley

95642.description:
You there! Thank the light you've come. Did Amberhall send you to find me?

No? Figures as much. Ashe Amberhall sent me down here to investigate the Twilight's Hammer. As you can see, they are digging for something within the Riverglades, but I need a sample of their witchcraft to figure out what.

It's imperative Farholde gets those samples. Please, $c. Take this catalyst. It's enchanted to absorb the powers of the cult. Runes, cultists, it doesn't matter. Just hold it aloft and it will do the rest.
95642.objectivesText: Absorb $1oa samples into the Crystal Catalyst from Twilight's Hammer cultists and Twilight Ritual Circles in the cave underneath Sunnyglade for Apprentice Claire.
95642.title: Abominable Magics

95643.description:
As Lady Amberhall's apprentice in the dark arts, I may not look it but I'm usually quite capable of handling things on my own. I did not, however, anticipate an entire cave of void-infused ogres.

If you managed to get all the way down here without being captured, you must be powerful yourself. I was not so lucky with those ogres and their masters roaming about. Do the world a favor and kill the hideous beasts. Nothing good comes from a fanatic with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.
95643.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Twilight Ritualists and $1oa Empowered Brutes within the caves underneath Sunnyglade.
95643.title: Indiscriminate Purge

95646.description:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646.objectivesText: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
95646.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647.description:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.objectivesText: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95664.description: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectivesText: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95682.description:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.objectivesText: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.title: Open the Maw

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95753.description:
<The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. 

It appears to be offering you a challenge.

Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.>
95753.objectivesText: Reach the other Odd Totem at the end of the massive skeleton before time runs out.
95753.title: Challenge of the Desert Wolf

95769.description:
Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit!

We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
95769.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bolts of Runecloth to Mez'dan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
95769.title: Threading a Solution

95770.description:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.
95770.objectivesText: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.
95770.title: Locating the Lost City

95772.description:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.objectivesText: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95772.title: Songblade Search

95773.description:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.
95773.title: Enemies in the Water

95775.description:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.description:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectivesText: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95787.description:
<Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.>

Could it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century!

Please, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
95787.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95787.title: Take Two With Water

95788.description:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectivesText: Collect $1oa I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95799.description:
I must write my colleague in Ironforge at the Explorer's League immediately. This is a discovery of historical proportions.

Would you mind delivering the letter to Ironforge for me? I will write a copy of my translations of the tablets for you.
95799.objectivesText: Bring Loremaster Dibbs' I'lalai Translations to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
95799.title: Findings for the Explorer's League

95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95810.description:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
95810.title: Lost Relic Carry

95818.description:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need $1oa Mithril Bars and $2oa Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for $3oa Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.objectivesText: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95818.title: A Quick Craft

95819.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95819.objectivesText: Bring the completed form to Jornah in The Barrens.
95819.title: Sign Me Up!

95820.description:
We have done well to create great relationships with the merchants and craftspeople of Orgrimmar. Among these excellent relationships is an orc named Karolek, a leatherworker who ensures a steady supply of hides and other useful equipment to us.

He also happens to be great at making signs!

If you'd like to get your sign made fast, I would recommend him over anyone else. Let him know I sent you.
95820.objectivesText: Meet Karolek at the Kodohide Leatherworkers shop in Orgrimmar.
95820.title: Karolek

95882.description:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout
95882.objectivesText: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.
95882.title: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas

95883.description:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectivesText: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95912.description:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper
95912.objectivesText: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.
95912.title: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo

95924.description:
Ye there! Aye, I'm talkin' ta ye! We've made the discovery of a lifetime down in Un'Goro! Can ye believe it?

There's just one problem... our dig site's been overrun by voracious beasts of the killin' nature. Very unpleasant indeed.

With yer help, we can reclaim our camp and git back ta workin'. Now, what do ye say? I'll make it worth yer while.
95924.objectivesText: Slay 6 Ravasaur Matriarchs, 9 Ironhide Ravasaurs and Venomridge in Shaper's Terrace.
95924.title: Panic at the Digsite

95925.description:
$C, we've made the discovery of a lifetime! I can't believe it; the ruins in Un'Goro are open!

We've already sent a team but they have encountered... trouble. If you're headed in there anyway would ya be able to finish this map?

It sounds like there's an Achromatic Crystal in there and an unearthed watcher somewhere near a giant Western Gate that sounds interesting.

The other landmarks that would be helpful are the Pillar of Assimilation, the Western Gate and the Regrowth Vestibule.
95925.objectivesText: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each.
95925.title: Mapping the Way Forward

95926.description:
You there! I have a job for someone of your... skills.

I have gotten word from my sources of a crystal found in Shaper's Terrace that can seemingly drain the elements around it. Or perhaps it can drain life essence itself. It is unclear from this report.

I must have a fragment of this crystal! Just think of the applications of such a powerful artifact.

Go to Shaper's Terrace and bring me back a sample of this colorless Achromatic Crystal, and I will reward you for your efforts.
95926.objectivesText: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.
95926.title: The Dark Crystal

95928.description:
Ah, it is good you have come here, $c.

I have been studying crystals of late and word has reached me about a peculiar set of crystals said to be from Un'Goro Crater. I have samples of the most basic ones, but I have heard tell of larger more potent crystals seen in a place called Shaper's Terrace.

I do not know much of this place aside from it containing these crystals that supposedly have the very elements within them. If you find yourself there, please bring me a sample of each color.
95928.objectivesText: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.
95928.title: Crystalline Elements

95934.description:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95934.objectivesText: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95934.title: Proof of Profit

95936.description:
The dragon's head is all teeth, scale, and ash -- a grisly prize taken from a grisly creature. Holding it, you feel the heat of its last fiery breath still radiating from its mouth.

While the threat Scaldaron once posed is no more, the warriors of Rog'mar ought to know about what happened here.
95936.objectivesText: Take the Head of Scaldaron to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95936.title: Hail the Dragonslayer

95943.description:
G'day, $Glad:lass;. Name's Bertrand, Bertrand Ironbrow! At yer service.

<Bertrand extends a filthy hand.>

These fine folk contracted me tae oversee construction of this here keep. What they lack in experience they make up for in spirit! Problem is, I misplaced me tools.

Had a bit of a run in with a few Twilight in a small grove northwest o' here. Had to choose between me life or me tools. On one hand, I'm alive. On the other... ye see where this is goin'.

Think ye could help find me tools?
95943.objectivesText: Locate the Foreman's Crate and return it to Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
95943.title: Foreman's Plight

95951.description:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.
95951.objectivesText: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.
95951.title: Fetch 'n' Fletch

95957.description:
Here ya go, champ. One drink for ol' grumpy guts over there. If this doesn't sober him up, nothin' will.

Oh and uh... wash your hands after touchin' this. And don't get it in your eyes.
95957.objectivesText: Deliver Zizplink's Frothing Mug to Gray Dawnbright in Powderfuse Port.
95957.title: Drink Up!

95982.description:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.
95982.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
95982.title: Not My Circus

95992.description:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani
95992.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
95992.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

96003.description:
As suspected, the vessels fused into something new--something powerful.

I suppose if the vessels capture stored energy, there must be a way to use that power to our advantage. Fel artifacts are rarely safe or easy to come by, but we might as well do something with it, hmm?

Time for a field test.

Take the crystal and use it against Bethra'zel and Mazzogore--two of their most powerful demons. Their presence alone has ensured the camp is well protected. Let's see if we can change that.
96003.objectivesText: Use the Eye of Endless Influence on Bethra'zel and Mazzogore to siphon their power, then deliver the killing blow.
96003.title: Drawing Down the Malevolent

96009.description:
One thing that never ceases to amaze me is the drive of humans. They see a desolate warzone teemin' with orcs and cultists and figure that's the perfect spot tae set up shop! Amazin'.

But, it's not me job tae tell 'em where to build. Just gotta show 'em how. And if we want this keep tae be as big as they say, we're gonna need lots o' wood.

With how dangerous the roads have become our lumber shipments from the mill tae the northwest are slowin' to a crawl. Think ye can fetch a few bundles for us?
96009.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Wood Bundles from Turner's Logging Camp for Bertrand Ironbrow in Farholde Keep.
96009.title: High Stakes

96010.description:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
96010.objectivesText: Recover shards and fragments of the pylons, found guarded at the Magram and Gelkis villages. Return them to Mordent Evenshade.
96010.title: Fragments of the Pylons

96015.description:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
96015.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
96015.title: A Miner Problem

96026.description:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
96026.objectivesText: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.
96026.title: Step Two: More Rock

96047.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

96047.objectivesText: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96050.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.objectivesText: Speak with Paxton Ganter near Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96050.title: Camping 101: Fishing

96063.description:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
96063.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
96063.title: Gaseous Gold

96075.description:
My employers are looking to get their hands on legal documents surrounding the ownership of Blackrock Mountain. Some kind of property dispute. In any case, if you could acquire these key records, I can afford to reward you generously.

Retrieve Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in the upper part of Blackrock Spire, an Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in the lower part of Blackrock Spire, and a Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in the Blackrock Depths.
96075.objectivesText: Acquire Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in Blackrock Spire, Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in Blackrock Spire, and Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96075.title: In Demand - Blackrock Legal Records

96076.description:
My employers are looking to get their hands on magical curiosities from the ruined elven city of Eldre'Thalas, now known as Dire Maul. Some kind of magical research. In any case, if you could acquire these items, I can afford to reward you generously.

Retrieve a Felvine Seed from Alzzin the Wildshaper in the eastern wing, an Ancient Memento from Prince Tortheldrin in the western wing, and an Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring from King Gordok in the northern wing.
96076.objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine Seed from Alzzin the Wildshaper, an Ancient Memento from Prince Tortheldrin, and an Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring from King Gordok, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96076.title: In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities

96081.description:
If there is one thing a fighting force always needs, it's bandages. Unfortunately, Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth. Thus, we depend on imports from the goblins or, if we are lucky, what we can take back from the orcs.

Currently, our supply of quality cloth is running low. I will have to start making bandages of old shirts before long. If you have the means to aid us, you would be saving many lives.
96081.objectivesText: Gather 20 Mageweave Cloth for Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep.
96081.title: Wound Dressings

96083.description:
You have done all you can here, for now.

If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church.

Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.
96083.objectivesText: Speak to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96083.title: Clerical Quarantine

96084.description:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
96084.objectivesText: Collect a sample of drinking water from the plains for Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96084.title: Something's in the Water

96085.description:
The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.
96085.objectivesText: Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96085.title: Upstream Contamination

96088.description:
Some researchers from Dalaran are looking for relics from the Titans and their followers, as well as their enemies in the Burning Legion. The relics are located in some tricky spots I can't reach. Recover them for me and I'll reward you generously.

Retrieve Ysera's Tear from the Shade of Eranikus in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, a Mark of Xavius from Varrox Bleakhoof in Blackmaw Hold, and Freya's Sigil from Nanaya in the Shaper's Terrace.
96088.objectivesText: Acquire Ysera's Tear from the Shade of Eranikus in the Sunken Temple, a Mark of Xavius from Varrox Bleakhoof in Blackmaw Hold, and Freya's Sigil from Nanaya in the Shaper's Terrace, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96088.title: In Demand - Titan Relics

96101.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.objectivesText: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.title: The Great Outdoors

96102.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.objectivesText: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96102.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96104.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!
96104.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96104.title: Song of the Strider

96105.description:
The whistle is made, $n.

Take it and go to the top of the hill south where the lions dwell.

Once you are ready to face your quarry, blow the whistle and the beast should appear.

I wish you luck in your hunt. May you return in glory.
96105.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96105.title: King of the Wild Plains

96109.description:
As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.

Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.

The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.
96109.objectivesText: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96109.title: A Hunter's Quiver

96125.description:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
96125.objectivesText: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
96125.title: In Need of Relief

96126.description:
I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
96126.objectivesText: Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.
96126.title: An Ogre's Captive

96130.description:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.objectivesText: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.title: Chakuyak

96135.description:
Euck, just bein' around these blasted totems is givin' me the willies--but that's good. This much twisted corruption will be exactly what we need tae summon the quilboar's elementals.

Go to the Thousand Needles and find a suitable spot for your defenses. The steam pools should work. They're rich with fire, earth, water, and air alike. Place these totems and be ready for a fight. The Razormane won't take too kindly to yer interference.
96135.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
96135.title: Heed My Call

96137.description:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Young Black Ravagers and $2oa Black Ravagers then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
96137.title: Ira's Dagger

96139.description:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.objectivesText: Search Raven Hill for anything of interest and return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.
96139.title: The Valor Family

96222.description:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.objectivesText: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
96222.title: Khan Hratha

96243.description:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.objectivesText: Find Teo Hammerstorm in Dun Morogh.
96243.title: Call of Earth

96255.description: <Something wriggles ominously within the bone pile as green ooze seeps out from under the freshly added bones.>
96255.objectivesText: Slay the Awakened Fel Ash Slime.
96255.title: Amalgamated Marrow

96260.description:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.objectivesText: Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.title: Stronger than Steel

96296.description:
<The second you near the pulsing nodule it falls from the tree, exposing a weeping green sap. It seems the tree has corruption within its bark that has spread deep, but the tree is not yet dead.

Looking around it is clear it has spread to some of the surrounding trees, but not all suffer from the same level of corruption.

Perhaps it is not too late to save the infected trees nearby.

Surely the Highfeathers would be grateful if you remove as many corrupted knots as you can find.>
96296.objectivesText: Find and remove $1oa Corrupted Knots from the trees nearby.
96296.title: Fetid Corruption

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You know, for a mortal I'm impressed with how easily you follow orders.

You just went in there and killed all of those people without batting an eye! It wouldn't be so bad to follow along in your bloody wake, even for a warlock. I imagine the demonic carnage would be beautiful.

Ahhhh... but now it's time for YOUR end of the deal, 'friend'. I've helped you dismantle those wannabe warlocks, take out their leaders and cripple their operations here.

I think I've earned my freedom.

<Felflick's eyes glimmer in anticipation.>

96322.description:
You know, for a mortal I'm impressed with how easily you follow orders.

You just went in there and killed all of those people without batting an eye!

Ahhhh... but now it's time for YOUR end of the deal, 'friend'. I've helped you dismantle the moronic Ashen Reign, take out their leaders and cripple their operations here.

I think I've earned my freedom.

<Felflick's eyes glimmer in anticipation.>

objectives.text: Decide What to do with Felflick

96322.title: A Revenge Now Bitter

96332.description:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.
96332.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.
96332.title: A Little Payback

96334.description:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.
96334.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect $1oa Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.
96334.title: Blood Red Bandanas

96335.description:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.
96335.objectivesText: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.
96335.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

96369.description: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. Many Kor'kron died to learn this news, but this knowledge could shake the Alliance to its core. You need to return to Commander Folkar and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>
96369.title: Bad News for Folkar

96381.description:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.
96381.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
96381.title: A Bit of Wet Work

96393.description:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.objectivesText: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96395.description:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.objectivesText: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403.description:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.title: Important Heirlooms

96408.description:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408.objectivesText: Investigate the campsite overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
96408.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

96476.description: Aeonas mentioned something about Felwood, so it's possible that's where he is. There's a small settlement in the southern portion of the woods there known as the Emerald Sanctuary. I'd suggest asking around there to see if anyone has seen him.

objectives.text: Look for signs of Aeonas at the Emerald Sanctuary
Use the rope to reach Aeonas

96476.objectivesText: Search for signs of Aeonas the Vindicated at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood.
96476.title: In Search of Aeonas

96558.description:
Beneath the shattered stones of that watchtower lies a cache we buried in haste, when the world was starting to burn. What little we carried from Hyjal rests there still. Take it--you have earned that much.

The pull is increasing... the mountain no longer holds me as it once did. I am unsure if we will ever speak again.

Because of you, I remember who I was, and who we were. Go with my thanks, and let this spirit finally be at peace.
96558.objectivesText: Recover the Battle Cache buried on Mount Hyjal.
96558.title: Soldier's Solace

96603.description:
Archmage Rhonin is presently abroad investigating a disturbance in the flow of magic across Azeroth. The Archmage has charged me with soliciting the aid of strong adventurers like yourself in gathering important field data to aid him.

Take this Arcane Censer. While afflicted by its magic, you will be able to extract motes of unstable magic from the most skilled spell casters and other singularly powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me said motes and the Kirin Tor will be in your debt.
96603.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.
96603.title: Unstable Magic

96605.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605.objectivesText: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96605.title: The Great Outdoors

96607.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

96607.title: The Great Outdoors
