Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608.objectivesText: Sit near Eric's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96608.title: The Great Outdoors

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ortak looks alarmed as you approach but calms as it becomes clear you aren't Scourge.>

You...you are not Scourge? But you are undead? How is this possible...?

Well, stranger, if you are offering to aid us here I will not turn you away. We have been trapped here since the end of the war. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

I would ask a favor of you, if you are willing. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.

96616.description:
Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal!

I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

Please, $c. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.
96616.title: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.objectivesText: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos

96629.title: Camping 101: Cooking

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Cook Torka in Razor Hill

96655.objectivesText: Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
96655.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96656.description:
$n, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.objectivesText: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
96656.title: The Adventurer

96658.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from William Pickman in Brill

96658.objectivesText: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.
96658.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96770.description:
There exists a troll witch doctor that goes by the name of Zum'rah. I have history with this particular troll, and I'd like you to kill him for me.

Go to the Sandfury stronghold of Zul'Farrak, deep in the deserts of Tanaris. Find Zum'rah inside and destroy him. Bring his head to me--intact--and I'll see that you are fairly compensated.
96770.objectivesText: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran.
96770.title: The Witch Doctor's Head

96771.description:
In the region known as the Riverglades to the southeast, there is a place called the Krol'dok Stronghold. A highborne known as Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen there in the company of the Twilight's Hammer.

I'd pay handsomely if you'd rid the world of this cretin for me. He brings shame to the proud lineage of the highborne by consorting with fanatics and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service. There are few enough of us left without worms like him sullying our good name.
96771.objectivesText: Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Zalfan Moonshadow.
96771.title: Vengeance of the Highborne

96772.description:
Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.
96772.objectivesText: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.
96772.title: The Dragon's Journal

96773.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb known as "The Coldbringer's Eye" to direct the movements of his lesser minions elsewhere.

Go into Razorfen Downs and retrieve the Coldbringer's Eye on our behalf, $c. The Kirin Tor would pay handsomely to obtain this artifact so that we may study it and understand its inner workings.
96773.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
96773.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

96774.description:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96775.description:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.
96775.objectivesText: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.
96775.title: Zum'rah's Head

96776.description:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
96776.objectivesText: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.
96776.title: An'she's Radiance

96783.description:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783.objectivesText: Steal a Syndicate uniform from Northfold Manor to infiltrate Stromgarde Keep.
96783.title: A Way In

96796.description:
This looks like something that the tinker in the hills, Kaylaena, could make use of. She barely visits ever since the loss of her mentor, Yaely.

Look for her workshop in the hills to the north. After Archimonde's fall in the great battle, the two of them scavenged what they could easily bring back themselves, picking many of the machines on these foothills clean.

Putting this debris to new use is better than allowing it to rust here. Your errand helps new life sprout where it was choked by metal.
96796.objectivesText: Bring the Spare Part to the tinker known as Kaylaena in lower Hyjal.
96796.title: Woods Workshop

96797.description:
We often try to find surviving family for many of our charges, and occasionally we find something hopeful. I've received word that Randal here may have a surviving family member. The man's name is Danneth, and he is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep. I need someone to travel there and find the man.

If you can, please convince Danneth to come retrieve his nephew. I don't think the two have ever met, but they are family all the same and Randal belongs with him.
96797.objectivesText: Travel to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and locate Sergeant Danneth.
96797.title: The Orphan

96799.description:
<Lieutenant Connar listens as you tell him the reason you are here.>

So, Danneth has an orphaned nephew in Dalaran? If you haven't spoken to him about this yet, I'd suggest you do so. He doesn't exactly seem like the parenting type, but he might surprise me.

If he does want to go and collect the boy once he's recovered, he has my blessing to take leave for that.
96799.objectivesText: Speak with Sergeant Danneth at Nethergarde Keep.
96799.title: A Heavy Responsibility

96800.description:
You there, $c. I have a matter I could use assistance with.

I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it!

Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
96800.objectivesText: Retrieve the book The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
96800.title: Past Due

96812.description:
Yes... yes, I will take the boy in. He is family and I'm all he has. I need to recover for a bit longer, but I'll be taking leave and heading to Dalaran as soon as I am able. 

Please return to the Matron and let her know that I am on my way. I'll do my best to ensure that my brother's child is kept safe and grows up strong.

I swear it.
96812.objectivesText: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran and inform her of Sergeant Danneth's intentions to take in Randal.
96812.title: Thicker Than Water

96825.description:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96830.description:
My axe still bled demon gore when I heard a human screaming high above.

I looked up and saw this man dangling in the claws of a great chimaera. He fought back fiercly causing the beast to lose its grip and drop him. 

From that height, no warrior walks away. Even enemies deserve dignity, so I dragged him into the shade to pass in peace.

For my part, I track the farseers' visions--friends remain in Hyjal, far northwest.

Find the remaining Horde in my stead. Honor requires me here.
96830.objectivesText: Look for signs of Horde in the northwest of Mount Hyjal.
96830.title: Farsight Guided

96875.description:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96876.description: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.objectivesText: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

96895.description:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.objectivesText: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
96895.title: The Argent Emissary

96897.description: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
96897.title: The Cult of the Damned

96912.description:
Heya pal, step right up! You look like you know which end of the sword goes where! 

It just so happens that I have a long list of challenges that only the most elite fighters will be able to accomplish. Wanna take a stab at it?
96912.title: Field of Honor: Week 1

96913.description: You again, eh? Ready for the next test? I hope you aren't squeamish. You might need to bleed for this one... or preferably make the other guys bleed first.
96913.title: Field of Honor: Week 2

96914.description: I'm seein' some potential here. This next challenge will require you to really get your hands dirty. Hope you're up for it!
96914.objectivesText: Kill 25 players of the enemy faction in Warsong Gulch.
96914.title: Field of Honor: Week 3

96931.description:
Listen, dirtwalker. I am, of course, known for my intellect and wit but there is one that is even more majestic and powerful than I.

Naturally, I am speaking of cleverest, most cunning, and comely of the Wild Gods, Jereman! Every bird knows her name, and she is wise beyond her wingspan. She certainly will know what is needed for that oldstone's magic.

She nests up in what you dirtwalkers call the Cradle of Tranquility. Touch the crow effigy on the old bridge and she may appear!
96931.objectivesText: Touch the Crow Effigy on the bridge overlooking the Cradle of Tranquility to call the Wild God, Jereman.
96931.title: Heading Up the Mountain

96978.description:
Ever since those nasty Blackthorne druids came to power many of the less powerful gods here on Hyjal have... well to be blunt they've attempted to upend the natural order of things.

The very worst offender of this is Kala'th.

<Jereman rolls her eyes.>

That silly deer seems to fashion herself and her herd as predators. Again.

Don't get me wrong, it was quite amusing at first, but now it is time we get things back in wing.

Go speak to her to see if you can bring her back to reason, please.
96978.objectivesText: Speak to the Wild God, Kala'th.
96978.title: Violent Venison

96983.description:
You're capable, fast, fearless. Fire will draw the demons from their hiding places, and with them, their warlords. They will come seeking dominance. Instead, they will find vengeance waiting. This is the moment where the will of the mountain speaks through us.

Come, let us carve a path through these hellspawn and end their reign. My blade yearns to cleave through their ranks.
96983.objectivesText: Fight your way through Dae'gun with Yashiro.
96983.title: Yashiro's Windwalk

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96987.description:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987.objectivesText: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
96987.title: Opportunistic Education

96988.description:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.title: Source of Power

96991.description:
The climb grows steeper from here, as you say. Even an empty pack weighs on tired legs. I would ask another kindness of you, traveler. Take my excess gear and carry it ahead to the Summit, where Marn Euhron aids in restoring a foothold near Nordrassil.

I will follow at my own pace when my ceremonies here are complete. When I arrive, I will reclaim them from him and assist him in their work. This way, we both honor the journey and gifts of the mountain.
96991.objectivesText: Deliver Galvinquam's Belongings to Marn Euhron in the Summit.
96991.title: Trail Assist

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ogunaro narrows his eyes as you approach.>

Lok'tar, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your... talents here.

If you are looking for a riding wolf, you have come to the right place, however know that riding and befriending a wolf is very different from the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

The bond between orc and wolf is not one chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

If you are here to bond with a wolf, I would suggest going to each and examining them. Return to me if you sense a kinship with one.

96994.description:
Lok'tar, $c. Come to bond with your first wolf? Good.

There is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf. They are no mere mount, but are a lifelong companion and friend.

Ours is not a bond chosen by vanity. No, each orc and wolf forms a special bond that goes beyond a mere purchase.

They will choose you as much as you will choose them. You will understand when you meet them.

Go and find which wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.
96994.objectivesText: Inspect the riding wolves to choose your first mount.
96994.title: Your First Riding Wolf

96999.description:
Whoever wore dis fought wit' purpose. An' Sen'jin be a small village... blood an' kin run close dere.

Somebody back home be missin' dis wrap--and da warrior who carried it.

When ya trek to Echo Isles, take dis wrap wit' ya. Bring it home to Sen'jin. Dey'll know who it belong to--and dey'll honor ya for seein' it returned.
96999.objectivesText: Take the War Paint Wrap to someone in Sen'jin Village.
96999.title: Wrap Return

97001.description:
Inside the wardrobe, a ledger records trades of hay, lumber, draft animals, and land. Other notes--personal and unfinished--are tucked between its pages.

The figures tell their own story: the Sawyer family was skilled at turning timber into weapons, tools, furniture, and wagons alike.

Thumbing through the pages reveals other kin of the family. Abigail Sawyer is listed among the relatives.

She would be very interested in this.
97001.objectivesText: Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in Undercity's War Quarter.
97001.title: Sawyer's Legacy

97003.description:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003.objectivesText: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97005.description:
There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
97005.objectivesText: Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.
97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97006.description:
I've added a note and my signature beside my name on the original page.

Take it to Royal Overseer Bauhaus at the Undercity Census and explain where it was found. He must know how it came to me while I remained at my shop.

You can be honest and say to him that Abigail Sawyer told another stranger her sob story and you happened to actually have the means to follow up on it.

Again, thank you for doing this for my family.
97006.objectivesText: Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Royal Overseer Bauhaus in Undercity's Trade Quarter.
97006.title: Notarized Claim

97007.description:
I've stamped the pertinent pages for Abigail's records and updated our own documents.

Abigail will have to send a follow-up to the Royal Census when she intends to transport any of the property into Forsaken territories.

You may return her ledger and bring with it a reminder: Her contractual obligations to the War Quarter's commissary are not yet fulfilled, so she would be prudent to wait before attempting to act on any of these pre-war ownership claims.
97007.objectivesText: Return the notarized Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in the War Quarter.
97007.title: Wood Remains

97022.description: Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.
97022.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
97022.title: Report to Danitha

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Greetings, paladin! I must admit I am surprised to see one of your order here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the chargers you are accustomed to.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land. These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

Greetings, warlock. I must admit I am surprised to see one of your talents here at my stables.

If you are looking for a mount, you have come to the right place, though they may pale in comparison to the felsteeds you are accustomed to summoning.

Regardless, I encourage you to peruse our steeds, should you want one. Ours are some of the finest steeds in the land, and they should still bear you as faithfully as your summoned infernal felsteed.

Go examine the horses to see if any are to your liking and return to me when you have made your choice.

97045.description:
Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
97045.objectivesText: Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.
97045.title: Your First Horse

97047.description:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.objectivesText: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.
97047.title: The Cook in the Cage

97048.description: Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
97048.objectivesText: Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.
97048.title: Returning to Port

97049.description:
If you're headed into Shaper's Terrace, I would ask a favor of you.

There are reports of slimes that live in the pools by the colorless Achromatic Crystal. I believe their essence could be of use in my experiments, and would like you to bring me some samples for study.

I will make it worth your while.
97049.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.
97049.title: Essence of Seeping Slimes

97119.description:
In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?
97119.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Ortak Lomgok in Elderwild.
97119.title: Now We're Cooking

97130.description:
Lan'dalock and I have been discussing a recent development in the south seas involving an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has suddenly appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Such a site has significant archeological value. We'd be highly interested in obtaining one of the idols that certain witch doctors amongst the ancient Gurubashi would use as a ritual focus for their blood magic.

Enter this "Drowned City" and recover one of these idols for us.
97130.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
97130.title: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets

97170.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a horse, for a fee of course.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding horses.
97170.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.
97170.title: Learning to Ride

97173.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
97173.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97173.title: Blackmaw Magic

97174.description: The time has come, $n. As in life, paladins of the Forsaken are not complete until they are able to form a bond with a charger. This is no ordinary steed, this is a powerful spirit of retribution. $B$BSpeak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep to learn more. She will guide you on what to do next. The road before you will be difficult, but as our orc allies like to say--blood and thunder $G brother : sister;!
97174.objectivesText: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97174.title: A Worthy Endeavor

97177.description:
With the blessings of the loa, take the censer. I be usin' it more than once to exorcise bad voodoo spirits, and it should serve ya well for the trials what be comin'.

You best be headin' back to Danitha now, $n. Ya quest continues with her.
97177.objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97177.title: Acts of Mercy

97179.description:
We require several things for the barding--runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, Arthas' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and Stratholme holy water for the spiritual imbuement. Lastly, I'd charge a modest fee for the labor and for the saddle and stirrups to go with the barding.

Bring me these materials, and I will be able to complete your barding. I'll get to work on the saddle while you work on gathering these items.
97179.objectivesText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Ott in Hillsbrad Foothills.
97179.title: Collection of Goods

97180.description:
<Ott wipes the sweat from his brow and grunts at his work approvingly.>

There you are. My trade is mostly in the creation of weapons, but I believe that this might be some of my finest work nonetheless. I thank you for the trust you and your fellow paladins have shown me.

No doubt Danitha Morr will want to see the work for herself as well. Take your barding to her, and give her my thanks for allowing me to complete this commission on your behalf.

Lok-tar, $c.
97180.objectivesText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep for inspection.
97180.title: Ott's Finest Work

97182.description:
A paladin charger's barding requires the blessing of a powerful equine spirit. In the ruins of Dire Maul the corrupted treant known as Tendris Warpwood has such a spirit imprisoned. Seek retribution on behalf of this spirit, and free it from its bondage. With luck, it may be willing to provide its blessing. 

To help ensure success, I'd also advise you to bring a special type of spiritually-attuned feed. Travel to Eastern Plaguelands and speak with the ranger known as Nathanos Blightcaller about this.
97182.objectivesText:
Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands may be able to provide such a feed.

Travel to the Dire Maul in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed to soothe it. 

Lastly, give it the Arcanite Barding and hope that it is willing to provide the needed blessing.
97182.title: An Offering of Vengeance

97186.description:
So you need feed to give to the incorporeal spirit of a horse? Interesting.

Yes, I suppose I can help you with what you need. I have spent a considerable amount of time rearing beasts that are... let's say--no longer entirely of this world, and I know a thing or two about how to sustain them.

I simply need some of the spiritually-enriched biscuits that the Argent Dawn sells... and a small offering of gold. For my time, of course.
97186.objectivesText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits for Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits. You'll also need to provide Blightcaller with 50 gold for his time.
97186.title: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed

97188.description:
Greetings, $c! You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to pilot a mechanostrider, for a fee of course.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about riding mechanostriders!
97188.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.
97188.title: Learning to Ride

97196.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
97196.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
97196.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

97197.description:
Muln tells me that there is a location in the deepest depths of a place called Blackrock Mountain where the barrier between Azeroth and the elemental plane has been damaged, allowing a myriad of elemental creatures from the realm of the Firelands to escape into this reality, including giants as large as an Anchor Pylon!

I'd very much like to study any fragments of material that could be gathered from one of these creatures. Would you brave the Blackrock Depths and recover a sample for me?
97197.objectivesText: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.
97197.title: Fragment of the Firelands

97198.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.
97198.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97198.title: Blackmaw Magic

97204.description:
Greetings, $c. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a kodo, for a fee of course.

Harb will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding the noble kodo.
97204.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.
97204.title: Learning to Ride

97205.description:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a galestrider, for a fee of course.

I will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding galestriders.
97205.objectivesText: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Genn Fairweather.
97205.title: Learning to Ride

97243.description:
Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.objectivesText: Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
97243.title: Call of Fire

97246.description:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97250.description:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97253.description:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.
97253.title: Parts and Pieces

97263.description: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97265.description:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
97265.objectivesText: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
97265.title: Hate the Hatefury

97275.description:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.title: Whuut's the Rush

97281.description:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.objectivesText: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97281.title: A Simmering Storm

97282.description:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
97282.title: Stormy Potential

97287.description:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.objectivesText: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.
97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97288.areaDescription: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.
97288.description:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.objectivesText: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.title: Unending Torment

97289.description:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.objectivesText: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.
97289.title: Unending Torment

97327.description:
It breaks my heart to admit, but my brothers and sisters inside Blackmaw Hold are irreparably corrupted.

If you bring me some of their personal belongings, I can at least give their families something to remember them by. Every bundle you recover will serve as a symbol of your service to my people.
97327.objectivesText: Enter Blackmaw Hold and recover $1oa Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
97327.title: Blackmaw Pouches

97328.description:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.title: Anything of Value

97332.description:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?
97332.objectivesText: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
97332.title: Twice Misplaced Trust

97378.description:
$n, you have proven you are a strong and dutiful hunter and I am impressed by your bravery. It is only because of this I offer you this hunt.

A wind serpent hunts along a road off the coast of Feralas and has been ambushing travelers, and leaving their corpses strewn about the road. It is clear she does not hunt out of necessity. This is a creature that no longer shares the Earthmother's blessing.

The windserpent Mirrorscale makes her lair at the bottom of the waterfall along the coast of Feralas.
97378.objectivesText: Bring Mirrorscale's Wing to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
97378.title: Mirrorscale

97386.description:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!
97386.objectivesText: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97386.title: The Offense of Grom'gol

97403.description:
These chimaeras are a cruel joke. Two tongues, both foul, snarling frost and hunger. As if this wasteland needed more teeth.

This clearing is all we have, constantly overcome by storms before we can settle further. The two-headed Chillwind Ravagers circle us, testing our resolve, bleeding our time.

We spend more hours driving them back than building anything of worth.

Cull them. Break their presence here. With fewer prowling beasts, we may yet carve something lasting from this frozen waste.
97403.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Chillwind Ravagers and return to Rilan Howard in northern Winterspring.
97403.title: Two-Headed Ravagers

97404.description:
There are two old matriarchs, long aged past their cub rearing cycles. Perhaps they are sisters. They could also be two kindred bears who've shared a similar passing of seasons.

Regardless of what has brought them together, they still have a ferocity and will to live that demands respect. Attempting to set up a camp like this one has been difficult for us, with these two grizzled Shardtooths.

Bring back the heads of Kuroma and Kamuro, and try to end them swiftly, skillfully, and with mercy.
97404.objectivesText: Kill the old shardtooth matriarchs, Kuroma and Kamuro, and return their heads to Sarna Brownhorn.
97404.title: Too Bad to Bear

97405.description:
Gnaz over there has been building that death trap for the competition all the way over in Kalimdor. I have been warning him that his constant late-night tinkering is making a ton of noise, and last night I saw an ogre peeking his ugly head out from behind that tree!

He's obsessed with this ambitious dream to win the Mirage Raceway Championships, but I'm obsessed with not getting mauled to death! Please head over the hill to the north and make sure they stop snooping around the place.
97405.objectivesText: Knaz Blunderflame wants you to kill $1oa Mosh'Ogg Spellcrafters, $2oa Mosh'Ogg Warmongers, $3oa Mosh'Ogg Maulers, and $4oa Mosh'Ogg Shaman at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97405.title: Noise Complaints

97446.description:
Ah, I've been expecting you $c. It would seem the winds have brought you to me this day. You have come seeking a kodo, correct?

The kodo is a noble beast that is slow to anger, and you would be hard pressed to find a more dependable companion.

Today you have an important choice to make. You and your kodo will travel the world together, so find which one speaks to you. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
97446.objectivesText: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.
97446.title: Your First Riding Kodo

97490.description:
Hey bub, I'm trying to break down some junk to get parts for my machine, but things are gettin' too hot.

I know what you're thinking, Winterspring? Getting hot? As you can see, my crusher and reployer are running, but sputtering hard! What they really need is something to cool 'em down that won't melt, slide, or burn off.

In the southern hills roams a nasty giant we call Hailspite. Put an end to Hailspite and bring me the frosty moss that grows on his crags. 

It might work for me!
97490.objectivesText: Search the southern hills of Winterspring for the giant known as Hailspite and recover the frost moss that grows upon him.
97490.title: Halt the Hail

97530.description:
A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes.

Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost.

I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.
97530.objectivesText: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.
97530.title: Dunemaul Dues

97534.description:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!
97534.objectivesText: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.
97534.title: Gritty Business

97536.description:
The Matter Transporter required experimentation to get right. Many tests were conducted on all sorts of materials... with various outcomes! Some of the results are no longer with us. Others have become dangerously charged!

These subjected objects emit an energy that burns if you stay near for too long. Almost like they've been charged with a year's worth of the desert sun's power.

Take this Crate of Radioactive Refuse and empty the contents in the sand a safe distance from town and other trash.
97536.objectivesText: Jhordy Lapforge wants you to return to him after you have dumped the Crate of Radioactive Refuse in the desert of Tanaris a safe distance away from Gadgetzan and other trash.
97536.title: Gnomish Garbage

97539.description:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539.objectivesText: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.
97539.title: Silky Sutures

97663.description:
I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later.

The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache.

Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?
97663.objectivesText: Slay ogres in the Dustbowl for Mus'hale's Stolen Supplies and use them to collect rubbings of the nearby stone etchings, then return to Mus'hale at Kargath.
97663.title: Supplies and Studies

97821.description:
<Upon the elemental's demise, a relic fell from its core that glimmered in the sand.

As it was tilted in your hands, the reflection of the surrounding environment obscured it from your own view. Only once you saw a cracked surface that warped the reflection was it clearly visible again.

Perhaps someone would be interested in this discovery.>
97821.objectivesText: Find someone in the Badlands that would be interested in this discovery.
97821.title: Mirage Mirror

97883.description:
Bring Blackhand's head to Major Mattingly at the city gates. He and his men will proclaim the great victory you have achieved this day, so that the rest of the Alliance may be inspired by it.

You've done a great justice this day, $n. One that all will remember--including our enemies.
97883.objectivesText: Bring the Head of Rend Blackhand to Major Mattingly in Stormwind.
97883.title: End of the Dark Horde

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You look like a well-preserved Forsaken, all things considered. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

97884.description:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
97884.objectivesText: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.
97884.title: Armory of Sunnyglade

97900.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900.objectivesText: Speak with Dwukk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97900.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97907.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.objectivesText: Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97907.title: Camping 101: Mining

97917.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97917.objectivesText: Speak with Betty Quin in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97917.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97919.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97919.objectivesText: Speak with Michelle Belle in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97919.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97923.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97923.objectivesText: Speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97923.title: Camping 101: Mining

97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.objectivesText: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
97926.title: Making Do

97927.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97927.objectivesText: Speak with Kray in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97927.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97928.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97928.objectivesText: Speak with Thrag Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97928.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97935.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97935.objectivesText: Speak with Brek Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97935.title: Camping 101: Mining

97936.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97936.objectivesText: Speak with Yonn Deepcut in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97936.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97940.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97940.objectivesText: Speak with Alanna Raveneye in the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97940.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97941.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97941.objectivesText: Speak with Jenna Lemkenilli in Auberdine in Darkshore to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97941.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97943.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97943.objectivesText: Speak with Astaia in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97943.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97948.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97948.objectivesText: Speak with Kurdram Stonehammer in Auberdine to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97948.title: Camping 101: Mining

97950.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97950.objectivesText: Speak with Trianna in Darnassus to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97950.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97953.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97953.objectivesText: Speak with Vance Undergloom in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97953.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97956.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97956.objectivesText: Speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97956.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97957.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97957.objectivesText: Speak with Faruza in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97957.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97959.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97959.objectivesText: Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97959.title: Camping 101: Mining

97963.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97963.objectivesText: Speak with Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97963.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97964.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97964.objectivesText: Speak with Aedi Thriceforged in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97964.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97965.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97965.objectivesText: Speak with Naleeia Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97965.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97967.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97967.objectivesText: Speak with Fenn Fairweather in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97967.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97968.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97968.objectivesText: Speak with Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97968.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97971.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97971.objectivesText: Speak with Mendalass Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97971.title: Camping 101: Skinning

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

97979.description:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.title: The Goddess Provides

97985.description:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.objectivesText: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
97985.title: Thundering Hearts

98025.description:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025.objectivesText: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
98025.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98028.description:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.objectivesText: Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
98028.title: Baron Marinous

98070.description:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Screeching Harpies, $2oa Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and $3oa Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
98070.title: Stop the Screeching

98071.description:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!

objectives.text: Fallrook Varietal delivered to Dun Garok

98071.objectivesText: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.
98071.title: Brewer's Trade

98072.description:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072.objectivesText: Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
98072.title: Crocs of the Sky

98155.description:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
98155.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98156.description:
$n, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
98156.objectivesText: Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
98156.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts

98190.description:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, $Glad:lass;. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.objectivesText: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
98190.title: A Friend of the Family

98209.description:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209.objectivesText:
Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.
98209.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98216.description:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216.objectivesText: Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.
98216.title: Understanding Our Present

98221.description:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221.objectivesText: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.
98221.title: From the Ashes

98230.description:
